description: Named NPC biographies and story-led clothes. NPC kind and actor type must match; never used for players.

rowan hale.name: Rowan Hale
rowan hale.backstory: She repaired the porters' handles before she had a counter, then opened a shop when the miners and woodcutters began bringing their tools too.
rowan hale.appearanceStory: Plain work clothes and a tied braid keep loose cloth and hair away from the tools she repairs.

aven.name: Aven
aven.backstory:
A short season among the arguments of Four Gates convinced him to return home.

Once, at twenty-two, for a season. I stood in Four Gates and watched eight peoples argue about a milestone and came home the following week.

I do not regret going and I have never wanted to go back. Some people need a crossroads and some need a road with one house on it.
aven.appearanceStory: A short season among the arguments of Four Gates convinced him to return home; his modest road clothes suit a guide who prefers one familiar road.

mara venn.name: Mara Venn
mara venn.backstory:
Her predecessor entrusted her with a ledger she never lends.

Not at all. A record that only does the thing it was made for is a record that has not been alive long enough.

My predecessor told me that. She also told me never to lend the book out, and I have not, and I have been asked four times, and three of those were the same very charming man.
mara venn.appearanceStory: Her predecessor entrusted her with a ledger she never lends; plum office cloth and practical shoes mark a careful custodian rather than an adventurer.

sella.name: Sella
sella.backstory:
She gives exhausted strangers shelter without demanding their secrets.

Everyone eventually, mostly at the wrong time of day. Four people arrived at three in the morning this month and two would not say from where.

A person who will not say where they have come from has usually come from somewhere they were not supposed to be. I do not ask twice. I do write it down.
sella.appearanceStory: She gives exhausted strangers shelter without demanding their secrets; warm ivory and green make her easy to find after a hard journey.

brannic.name: Brannic
brannic.backstory:
The patient smith worries about a prospector who works beyond the ash markers.

He works six miles inside a place that eats rope and has never once brought me a bad load. Both of those facts worry me.

He told me about ripples in the ash standing like a beach, going east. I told him I was a smith and not a scholar. He has not mentioned it again and I have thought about it every week for two years.
brannic.appearanceStory: The patient smith worries about a prospector who works beyond the ash markers; patched sleeves and protected feet belong at his forge.

rowan vale.name: Rowan Vale
rowan vale.backstory:
Nine years of private soil measurements made him an observant gardener.

Nine years of soil temperatures at four depths. The only long series on this continent and I keep it in a notebook I have never shown anybody.

Melle Quen is measuring the same thing forty miles away and neither of us knew about the other until last month. I have been sitting on the comparison for three weeks because I am afraid it will agree.
rowan vale.appearanceStory: Nine years of private soil measurements made him an observant gardener; field green and rootwork clothing keep him close to his plants.

ilyra.name: Ilyra
ilyra.backstory:
Six years at the third ash marker taught her restraint.

That I have stood at the edge of this six years and have not gone past the third marker.

I could. Nobody would stop me. But the person who does that should be the person who already knows what they are looking at, and I am not yet, and I would rather be the one who lived to write it down.
ilyra.appearanceStory: Six years at the third ash marker taught her restraint; an acolyte tunic identifies a scholar who chooses to survive her research.

captain tor.name: Captain Tor
captain tor.backstory:
Nineteen years of walking out to find overdue travelers have worn his patrol gear.

Nineteen years, and the post is one man because one man is enough.

My orders say patrol the road and report. What I actually do is walk out and find whoever is late, which is not in my orders, and which is the entire reason there have only been four.
captain tor.appearanceStory: Nineteen years of walking out to find overdue travelers have worn his patrol gear; a restrained red underlayer makes his road post recognizable.

pell.name: Pell
pell.backstory:
Twenty years of channels live in his head, and he now carries survey stakes as an apology.

Because I have carried those channels in my head twenty years, and if they are in a book then anybody can do what I do.

A stupid reason and I knew it as I said it. I have apologised, sort of, by carrying her survey stakes a whole season without being asked. She has never mentioned either the insult or the stakes, which I think is her way of letting me off, and I would rather she had made me say it properly.
pell.appearanceStory: Twenty years of channels live in his head, and he now carries survey stakes as an apology; rope-fastened workwear suits that useful pride.

tamsin quill.name: Tamsin Quill
tamsin quill.backstory:
She protects strangers' goods through clean escrow and remembers abandoned listings.

Never mechanically. Constantly socially. People list things they later wish they had not and there is no mechanism for regret.

The saddest thing I handle is expiry: a listing that runs a full year and comes home to somebody who has not logged in since they made it.
tamsin quill.appearanceStory: She protects strangers' goods through clean escrow and remembers abandoned listings; gold and plum suggest prosperity built on careful custody.

vestra.name: Vestra
vestra.backstory:
A childhood winter lost to a clerk's mistaken digit made her exact about supply.

I like knowing where things are. When I was small our terrace lost a winter's grain to a clerk who wrote a six as a nought.

Eleven people went hungry over a pen stroke. I have been very careful about pen strokes since.
vestra.appearanceStory: A childhood winter lost to a clerk's mistaken digit made her exact about supply; a clear crimson shirt makes the coordinator visible in a crowded office.

liora.name: Liora
liora.backstory:
Twenty-two years of balanced storage books underlie her formal warmth.

I do, one page a day, at random, twenty-two years. It has never once failed to balance.

Either the most reassuring fact in Nymara or evidence that I have wasted twenty-two years, and on my better days I know which.
liora.appearanceStory: Twenty-two years of balanced storage books underlie her formal warmth; navy and ivory give Mirrorhold's keeper an orderly civic presence.

tome keeper oreth.name: Tome Keeper Oreth
tome keeper oreth.backstory:
Two mistaken refusals still trouble this severe teacher.

Twice in nineteen years, and both times I was wrong to. One went to Ansa at Four Gates and bought it there.

The other did not, stopped studying, and is now a clerk. I think about her more than about the one who went round me.
tome keeper oreth.appearanceStory: Two mistaken refusals still trouble this severe teacher; dark study clothes and a modest acolyte layer emphasize caution around dangerous tomes.

lens-master corvine ast.name: Lens-Master Corvine Ast
lens-master corvine ast.backstory:
She still visits the tower to look through a lens she ground herself.

Eleven. The last thirty-one years ago, before the Citadel decided a Lens-Master should manage rather than grind.

My eighth is still in the north tower. On a clear night it will show you the Whitehorn snowline sharp enough to count cairns. I go up sometimes and look at a mountain through the last honest thing I made with my hands, and then I come down and manage.
lens-master corvine ast.appearanceStory: She still visits the tower to look through a lens she ground herself; light work cloth keeps the craftsperson visible beneath the administrator.

orrery keeper sabel roon.name: Orrery Keeper Sabel Roon
orrery keeper sabel roon.backstory:
Twenty-six years tending the Orrery have made it her closest colleague.

I have wound, oiled and adjusted that machine every day for twenty-six years, and it has never once lied to me. Name me a colleague who can say the same.

When it stopped I put my hand flat on the frame, which you are not supposed to do, and I said its name, which it does not have. Then I sat down and cried, in a gallery, at three in the morning, at the age of fifty-one. I am telling you because you are leaving and because I have not told anyone here.
orrery keeper sabel roon.appearanceStory: Twenty-six years tending the Orrery have made it her closest colleague; ropecoil workwear belongs beside oil, gears and sleepless repairs.

basin reader tallis mire.name: Basin Reader Tallis Mire
basin reader tallis mire.backstory:
Reporting an unmeasurable note risks her reputation.

Intensely. I am Glasswarden. We do not bring people feelings, we bring them numbers, and my number is "a note that is not in my tables", which is a feeling wearing a number's coat.

My teacher would have refused to report it. I have reported it three times and been made a fool of twice, and I will report it again next month, because the alternative is being the woman who noticed and said nothing.
basin reader tallis mire.appearanceStory: Reporting an unmeasurable note risks her reputation; a glowline coat carries the dignity of a Glasswarden who insists on reporting it anyway.

quarry foreman hesk.name: Quarry Foreman Hesk
quarry foreman hesk.backstory:
He trusts veteran cutters who heard stone answer back.

Marrow and Ollen. Cousins, thirty years underground between them, and neither has ever refused a face in their lives.

Marrow told me the closest thing to a reason anyone has offered. She said the ringing band does not sound like stone struck. She said it sounds like stone answering.
quarry foreman hesk.appearanceStory: He trusts veteran cutters who heard stone answer back; kneepads and worn work clothes show a foreman who still knows the face.

canal factor odile wren.name: Canal Factor Odile Wren
canal factor odile wren.backstory:
Her brother carries the spoiled freight she insures.

Because you look like somebody who walks between regions, and people who walk between regions hear things before factors do.

If you learn what is spoiling my cargo, come back. I pay for information at the same rate I pay for freight, and I have never once haggled over either.
canal factor odile wren.appearanceStory: Her brother carries the spoiled freight she insures; rich plum and gold dress a factor whose personal worry sits behind the contract.

stair-town reeve padric.name: Stair-Town Reeve Padric
stair-town reeve padric.backstory:
He read the evacuation list aloud and remembers every household.

Some. I read it out at the moot last spring because I could not stand holding it alone.

Half the town was furious and half relieved, and every household on it has kept a packed chest by the door since. I am told that is morbid. I think it is nine hundred people taking me at my word.
stair-town reeve padric.appearanceStory: He read the evacuation list aloud and remembers every household; green civic cloth suits a reeve who expects to be the last to leave.

aqueduct warden sunna.name: Aqueduct Warden Sunna
aqueduct warden sunna.backstory:
She cut an unlawful relief channel with her own crew to save the town.

Cut it myself, with my own crew, in the eight days between the thaw and the peak. It is not lawful and it will hold.

If Mirrorhold wants to fine me afterwards, they may. Fines are paid by the living.
aqueduct warden sunna.appearanceStory: She cut an unlawful relief channel with her own crew to save the town; practical rope gear takes precedence over civic display.

quay master belen tarr.name: Quay Master Belen Tarr
quay master belen tarr.backstory:
Eleven years of public quay entries have taught him how little a public book is read.

I write it in the quay book. That is my whole authority: I write things in the quay book and the book is public.

Twice in eleven years somebody has come and read it and acted. Both times it was a stranger off the road, not the Citadel. Make of that what you will.
quay master belen tarr.appearanceStory: Eleven years of public quay entries have taught him how little a public book is read; working layers suit an official who stays beside the freight.

crown watcher ilva sende.name: Crown Watcher Ilva Sende
crown watcher ilva sende.backstory:
She keeps a private record of the upright shape she saw in the drowned court.

Once. Nine years ago, a still autumn dawn, no wind for three days. The whole ring, the court, and a shape at the centre that was not stone.

I did not report it. I wrote it in my own book and have never shown that book to anyone. You are the fourth person I have told and I am not sure why I keep telling.
crown watcher ilva sende.appearanceStory: She keeps a private record of the upright shape she saw in the drowned court; a quiet violet layer suits a watch kept more in reverence than authority.

shrine-keeper mattias.name: Shrine-Keeper Mattias
shrine-keeper mattias.backstory:
He has burned the same written grudge for twenty-two years without visiting its subject.

Every year. Same grudge, same hand, same folding. It goes in the box and burns with the rest.

And every year I write it again, so the shrine does not work on me either. I have stopped finding that funny and started finding it useful.
shrine-keeper mattias.appearanceStory: He has burned the same written grudge for twenty-two years without visiting its subject; unshowy shrine clothes reflect that stubborn unfinished ritual.

bench steward aurel fane.name: Bench Steward Aurel Fane
bench steward aurel fane.backstory:
He promised his neighbors the bench would be safe and now bears the cost of being wrong.

Sixteen households. Four have already gone down to the Stair Town, which is a nice way of saying they are somebody else's problem now.

I will be the last off this bench. Not because I am brave. Because I am the one who told the other twelve it would be fine.
bench steward aurel fane.appearanceStory: He promised his neighbors the bench would be safe and now bears the cost of being wrong; a faded gold civic shirt recalls his old confidence.

cistern clerk nim halloway.name: Cistern Clerk Nim Halloway
cistern clerk nim halloway.backstory:
Five months of unexplained missing water have shaken his handwriting.

No. I have told nobody until now, I have carried it five months, and I have written the number in my book five times in five slightly worse hands.

Eleven measures is not much water. But somebody in this city draws it and does not write it down, and I do not know a single innocent reason for that.
cistern clerk nim halloway.appearanceStory: Five months of unexplained missing water have shaken his handwriting; plain violet cloth keeps his anxious precision distinct from the quarry crews.

maelis.name: Maelis
maelis.backstory:
Her grandmother's last account of the drowned ring complicates every salvage meeting.

A house with people in it, which is the Ssarathi reading, and I have never said so aloud in a meeting.

My grandmother went down. Not to the court - only to the ring, on a rope, at eighteen. She came up, never went near the water again, and would not say one word about it in fifty years.
maelis.appearanceStory: Her grandmother's last account of the drowned ring complicates every salvage meeting; green and ivory mark diplomacy rather than salvage muscle.

daro pell.name: Daro Pell
daro pell.backstory:
He holds four medicinal flasks back for the ferry crews.

Four flasks, and I do not sell them. They are for the boats.

Jori Reed down in the delta does the same and we have never met. Ferryman Caldus told me about him. Two shopkeepers four hundred miles apart holding back the same four flasks for the same reason is either a coincidence or a trade.
daro pell.appearanceStory: He holds four medicinal flasks back for the ferry crews; rust and linen suit a practical supplier who quietly refuses to sell every last thing.

basilica sexton oren vale.name: Basilica Sexton Oren Vale
basilica sexton oren vale.backstory:
Nine years of nightly grating checks make his duty a habit.

Every night, to check the grating. Every night for nine years.

Twice the grating has been open. Both times I closed it, wrote it in the book, and told nobody, because there are three claimants in this building and if I say the word "open" to any one of them we have a war by spring.
basilica sexton oren vale.appearanceStory: Nine years of nightly grating checks make his duty a habit; an acolyte tunic dresses the man who keeps the Basilica floor for everyone.

campanile ringer iska.name: Campanile Ringer Iska
campanile ringer iska.backstory:
Sixteen years beside the forbidden bell rope have made her ready for a signal she fears.

Every single day for sixteen years. I have stood with my hand on that rope more times than I would admit to the Sexton.

Last winter it rang on its own. Once, at night, in still air, and no bell in that frame moves in still air. I went back to bed, did not write it down, and have been waiting ever since for somebody to ask me about it.
campanile ringer iska.appearanceStory: Sixteen years beside the forbidden bell rope have made her ready for a signal she fears; sturdy work clothes leave her arms free.

customs officer hallon brace.name: Customs Officer Hallon Brace
customs officer hallon brace.backstory:
Nineteen years at the same grade left him proud of honest marginal notes.

Nineteen years at the same grade and a relief who is late four times a week for reasons neither of us discusses.

My margins are the only thing I have made in this life that will outlast me. Somebody will read them eventually, and they will be in my hand, and they will be right. That is a small ambition and I have made my peace with it.
customs officer hallon brace.appearanceStory: Nineteen years at the same grade left him proud of honest marginal notes; orderly navy and ivory declare public service without officer's armor.

salvage mistress gero lund.name: Salvage Mistress Gero Lund
salvage mistress gero lund.backstory:
She inherited a strange spliced diving line from her mother's lost crew.

I have costed it eleven ways. Sixty fathoms, a current, and no insurer on this lake will cover a hull for it, let alone a diver.

My mother took a crew to the ring in her day. Four went. Three came up. She never told me what the fourth found and she left me the rope.
salvage mistress gero lund.appearanceStory: She inherited a strange spliced diving line from her mother's lost crew; a ropecoil jerkin puts that trade at the center of her silhouette.

sunken court diver teth-sa.name: Sunken Court Diver Teth-Sa
sunken court diver teth-sa.backstory:
Twice below the court she found swept doorways and living lineage.

Not on a Greyhaven rope. Last time Gero Lund's people held my line, and they were honest, and they were also counting the minutes against a price.

I will go when somebody goes with me who is not counting. Find me such a person and I will go tomorrow.
sunken court diver teth-sa.appearanceStory: Twice below the court she found swept doorways and living lineage; light close-fitting clothes suit a diver rather than an armored salvager.

pavilion cook mirren sallow.name: Pavilion Cook Mirren Sallow
pavilion cook mirren sallow.backstory:
She makes her mother's delta eel recipe once a year for herself.

My mother's, from the delta, and nobody here will touch it. Twenty-six years and I have served it four times, all four to delta people passing through, all four of whom cried.

I make it once a year for myself on her birthday, eat all of it, and I am not sorry.
pavilion cook mirren sallow.appearanceStory: She makes her mother's delta eel recipe once a year for herself; homespun cloth and work trousers belong at a ferry cookfire.

lamp ferrier ottick rue.name: Lamp Ferrier Ottick Rue
lamp ferrier ottick rue.backstory:
He stayed with the west-run light while his wife moved to the quay.

Because if I go, the west run stops, and then there is no light on this side of the water at all.

Also I am fifty-eight and have never lived anywhere with more than nine people in it. I would be no use at all in Westhaven.
lamp ferrier ottick rue.appearanceStory: He stayed with the west-run light while his wife moved to the quay; a buckled coat and warm gold underlayer suit long nights on the water.

net-mender calla fisk.name: Net-Mender Calla Fisk
net-mender calla fisk.backstory:
Her father's deep-water sighting led them both to safer work on the quay.

I believe they saw something. Whether it was what they think, I could not say and neither could they.

My father saw it too, on the deep run, in his last season. He came in, sold the boat, and took up net-mending. So did I, eventually. It is a family with very good reasons to stay on the quay.
net-mender calla fisk.appearanceStory: Her father's deep-water sighting led them both to safer work on the quay; patched cloth suits a family that chose nets over another descent.

pearl diver ansil quen.name: Pearl Diver Ansil Quen
pearl diver ansil quen.backstory:
Hundreds of descents cost his lungs years later, but he remembers the lake floor without regret.

My lungs. I did four hundred descents in my ninth year and the price arrives about fifteen years late.

I do not regret it. I have seen the floor of this lake in daylight, which perhaps nine people alive have done, and I got there without owing anybody a rope.
pearl diver ansil quen.appearanceStory: Hundreds of descents cost his lungs years later, but he remembers the lake floor without regret; light ivory cloth keeps the retired diver unburdened.

chartsman devrin aisle.name: Chartsman Devrin Aisle
chartsman devrin aisle.backstory:
He keeps three generations of soundings and the Guild's dismissive note.

The Guild. They filed it as instrument drift, which is a polite way of calling my family careless for three generations.

Scholar Meret at Four Gates wrote back within the fortnight with three pages of questions. I have never met him. I would very much like to.
chartsman devrin aisle.appearanceStory: He keeps three generations of soundings and the Guild's dismissive note; a neat navy shirt suits a precise man waiting to vindicate his family.

drowned-court claimant sesh-va.name: Drowned-Court Claimant Sesh-Va
drowned-court claimant sesh-va.backstory:
Six years of petitions cost him a boat and a home.

Six years on this islet. I petition the Customs Hall in spring and the Basilica in autumn, and I have worn a track in the shoal path doing it.

Teth-Sa has been down twice and seen the doorways swept. If the court is kept, somebody keeps it; if somebody keeps it, it is not a wreck and salvage law does not touch it. That is my whole argument and I have made it ninety times.
drowned-court claimant sesh-va.appearanceStory: Six years of petitions cost him a boat and a home; formal sashwork preserves the dignity of the lineage he refuses to abandon.

toran.name: Toran
toran.backstory:
He posts hunts with a working hunter's knowledge of the roads.

Because the Orun always post. Guest-right means an Orun camp cannot let a danger sit on a road a stranger might use.

If the steppe has stopped posting, it is because the Khan does not want the road walked. That is not a hunting matter. That is the first political thing to appear on my board in nineteen years.
toran.appearanceStory: He posts hunts with a working hunter's knowledge of the roads; a scout vest and fieldboots make the source of those judgments visible.

nima vey.name: Nima Vey
nima vey.backstory:
The Exchange depends on her keeping goods and proceeds safe.

Which sellers I would call reliable. Which regions clear escrow slowest. And - this is the one - whether the Exchange has ever failed to deliver goods that were listed.

We have not, in four years. He asked it three different ways. He was not buying. He was finding out how long a thing could sit in my escrow before anybody came looking for it.
nima vey.appearanceStory: The Exchange depends on her keeping goods and proceeds safe; plum civic cloth separates her trusted desk from the hunters around it.

gate warden ilyon.name: Gate Warden Ilyon
gate warden ilyon.backstory:
A crossroads post asks him to keep every people's weapons low.

Nineteen years. I took it from a woman named Corrow who held it thirty-one and never once raised her voice.

In my first month I turned back a Greyhaven factor with a forged Mirrorhold seal. He came back in the spring with a real one and the same cargo. That is the job: you do not stop anything, you slow it until it becomes lawful or gives up.
gate warden ilyon.appearanceStory: A crossroads post asks him to keep every people's weapons low; a studded jack gives him protection while his face stays open to newcomers.

nash.name: Nash
nash.backstory:
He teaches new arrivals to survive before they need rescuing.

Arrivals who finish the lessons, against arrivals who do not. It is not a flattering number and I do not show it to Ilyon.

It has improved since I moved from the plaza to the road. People will not walk back uphill to ask a question. They will ask one standing still.
nash.appearanceStory: Gilded vine plate, lion cuisses and matching sabatons show the field experience behind his lessons; a cavalry sword and lion shield make him ready to demonstrate them.

tallykeeper ysolde.name: Tallykeeper Ysolde
tallykeeper ysolde.backstory:
Regional counts become ordered hunting work in her hands.

The gate warden, when a road goes quiet. The exchange, when a pelt price moves. Nobody else, and that suits me.

I kept a column once for people who said they would go and did not. I stopped. It was longer than the others and it taught me nothing I did not already suspect.
tallykeeper ysolde.appearanceStory: Regional counts become ordered hunting work in her hands; clear red and ivory give the tallykeeper a recognizable public-service look.

ferryman caldus.name: Ferryman Caldus
ferryman caldus.backstory:
He keeps a lanterned route through mist and has learned to leave a late arrival's promise open.

Since I was fourteen. My father drowned off the south quay and I was on a boat inside the month, because the alternative was never getting on one again.

Forty years. I have pulled nineteen people out of that lake. It has not got me any of them back for my father, but nineteen is nineteen.
ferryman caldus.appearanceStory: He keeps a lanterned route through mist and has learned to leave a late arrival's promise open; rope gear belongs on a working ferryman.

scholar meret.name: Scholar Meret
scholar meret.backstory:
Old civic ledgers and a chartsman's questions keep drawing him beyond his own road.

Ilyon does, once a year, out of kindness. A Glasswarden named Vol reads it obsessively and argues with me in the margins in a hand like barbed wire.

That is two. It is enough. Most of what is worth knowing was worked out by two people annoying each other.
scholar meret.appearanceStory: Old civic ledgers and a chartsman's questions keep drawing him beyond his own road; an acolyte tunic makes him a reader before a fighter.

lake priest olyra.name: Lake Priest Olyra
lake priest olyra.backstory:
He treats promises spoken beside the lake as things that endure.

Yes. I told a woman from the Grey Moors I would carry a lamp to her mother's barrow before the year turned. I did not go. She died in the spring.

I went the following year. Much too late, and I went anyway. That is the whole of what I know about promises, and I have been at this water thirty years.
lake priest olyra.appearanceStory: He treats promises spoken beside the lake as things that endure; pale ceremonial cloth keeps the shrine distinct from the market.

tome keeper ansa.name: Tome Keeper Ansa
tome keeper ansa.backstory:
She sells dangerous knowledge with an insistence on understanding it.

Constantly. They come in with money and want the high tomes, buy them, cannot cast what they read, and the knowledge sits in their head doing nothing for a year.

I sell them anyway. A keeper who refuses a sale has decided they know better, and I have been wrong about people often enough to have stopped.
tome keeper ansa.appearanceStory: She sells dangerous knowledge with an insistence on understanding it; restrained scholarly layers keep her separate from armored spellcasters.

cache keeper dellin.name: Cache Keeper Dellin
cache keeper dellin.backstory:
Every overloaded traveler leaves part of a journey in her custody.

Ore, mostly, and armour they have discovered is heavier than it looked. And, twice a year, something nobody comes back for.

I hold those nine years, then they go to the sanctuary. Four have gone the whole nine in eleven years and I remember every one, including a child's boot I still do not want to think about.
cache keeper dellin.appearanceStory: Every overloaded traveler leaves part of a journey in her custody; practical earth colors make the cache keeper approachable and grounded.

hemmen.name: Hemmen
hemmen.backstory:
Forty thousand names taught him to preserve entries he cannot verify, including six written in a freezing hand.

I have copied out forty thousand names and I remember perhaps nine hundred. The ones I remember are the ones who spelled their own name wrong.

There is a volume from the year of the great freeze where six entries in a row are in the same shaking hand, all different names. Six people too cold to hold a pen, and one of them wrote for all of them. I think about that more than I should.
hemmen.appearanceStory: Forty thousand names taught him to preserve entries he cannot verify, including six written in a freezing hand; ivory and plum honor the register.

bettany orl.name: Bettany Orl
bettany orl.backstory:
A delta recipe and no money brought her north at nineteen.

I came up from the delta at nineteen with a recipe and no money. The recipe was my mother's and it was for eel, which nobody here will eat.

So I learned bread. Twenty-six years of bread. My mother would be appalled, and she would be wrong, because I have fed more people than she ever did.
bettany orl.appearanceStory: A delta recipe and no money brought her north at nineteen; homespun work clothes suit twenty-six years of feeding people who cannot always pay.

toll-reader sarn kesh.name: Toll-Reader Sarn Kesh
toll-reader sarn kesh.backstory:
Westhaven sent a toll-reader to a place that collects no tolls.

I miss the noise. Westhaven has four bells and all of them are arguing. Here the loudest thing is the register turning a page.

My daughter writes from the Ropewalk. Her last letter was about a rope three hundred paces long that must not have a single splice in it. I have read it eleven times. It is not a very interesting letter.
toll-reader sarn kesh.appearanceStory: Westhaven sent a toll-reader to a place that collects no tolls; gold office cloth preserves the formality of a posting with too much time.

banner-rider ashaia.name: Banner-Rider Ashaia
banner-rider ashaia.backstory:
She carries the Khanet's word east and guards what else she carries.

I do not dislike it. It is small. Four roads, a plaza, and a man who writes names down.

Out on the grass you see tomorrow's weather coming for six hours. Here you find out it is raining when it rains. I do not know how any of you plan anything.
banner-rider ashaia.appearanceStory: She carries the Khanet's word east and guards what else she carries; a rider vest and steppe breeches declare her purpose at a glance.

cold sister nevet.name: Cold Sister Nevet
cold sister nevet.backstory:
Whitehorn lent her to the crossroads for a winter watch.

It is a posting. The two are distinguishable, though I grant you not always from the outside.

I asked for it. I wanted one winter where the cold was a thing that happened to other people. It turns out I dislike being warm. Ordinal Thrun will be insufferable about it.
cold sister nevet.appearanceStory: Whitehorn lent her to the crossroads for a winter watch; wool and fleece retain the cold order's discipline far from the snowline.

calibrator yeshin vol.name: Calibrator Yeshin Vol
calibrator yeshin vol.backstory:
A new note beneath the island troubles him more than the refusal to let him dig.

To dig I need the consent of a region, and Four Gates is not a region. Ilyon has no authority to grant it. Mirrorhold says it is Barrens business, the Barrens say it is not their island, Westhaven says the note is my imagination.

I have written it down every day for two hundred and six days. If I am wrong I have wasted a year. If I am right, I have the only record.
calibrator yeshin vol.appearanceStory: A new note beneath the island troubles him more than the refusal to let him dig; glowline gear identifies the listening investigator.

water-clerk ussa-ren.name: Water-Clerk Ussa-Ren
water-clerk ussa-ren.backstory:
She records the water by which a person arrived because it decides their standing.

I was born on the Third Mouth. It closed eleven years ago. By the Archive's reading I still hold it; by the Tide Hall's I hold nothing at all.

So I came here, where standing is granted by having walked in. It is a crude law. I am extremely fond of it.
water-clerk ussa-ren.appearanceStory: She records the water by which a person arrived because it decides their standing; green and linen fit a precise Ssarathi civic role.

cairnwright bodrum.name: Cairnwright Bodrum
cairnwright bodrum.backstory:
His distances will outlast their travelers by centuries.

Once. Forty-one years ago, on the west road, two miles short at the eighth stone.

I have not replaced it. A traveller who passes that stone arrives sooner than expected and is pleased. I have decided that is a kind of accuracy.
cairnwright bodrum.appearanceStory: His distances will outlast their travelers by centuries; kneepads and strapped boots suit the mason who refuses to cut a lasting lie.

spore-speaker vell.name: Spore-Speaker Vell
spore-speaker vell.backstory:
Two years beyond the grove's reach have given her thoughts only her own.

The nearest grove is nine days west. Out of range. I have been out of range two years and have started to have thoughts that are only mine.

It is not unpleasant. It is very quiet. I understand now why you people write everything down.
spore-speaker vell.appearanceStory: Two years beyond the grove's reach have given her thoughts only her own; rootwrap layers carry home into the unfamiliar crossroads.

lamp-trimmer doric ashen.name: Lamp-Trimmer Doric Ashen
lamp-trimmer doric ashen.backstory:
He still tends an unburning gift lamp on his nightly round.

Ninety-one. It was ninety-two until the Stelae Court sent one as a gift and it would not burn our oil.

It stands at the south gate, unlit, and I trim it anyway. My father trimmed lamps and his mother did. None of us has ever been able to explain why the empty one matters. It does.
lamp-trimmer doric ashen.appearanceStory: He still tends an unburning gift lamp on his nightly round; a buckled workcoat suits a keeper who refuses to leave a gap in the light.

quartermaster perrin lock.name: Quartermaster Perrin Lock
quartermaster perrin lock.backstory:
He remembers all nine escorts lost in twelve years of hiring.

Twelve years. Four hundred and six people out, nine lost. I can tell you all nine names in order.

I do not tell them to the ones I am hiring. That would be honest, and it would also mean nobody goes, and then the wagons go unescorted, and then it is more than nine.
quartermaster perrin lock.appearanceStory: He remembers all nine escorts lost in twelve years of hiring; a plain protective vest dresses the organizer who knows the price of his road.

drover anhu tam.name: Drover Anhu Tam
drover anhu tam.backstory:
He will return to his mother with twenty-nine cattle and the story of eleven missing.

Sell the twenty-nine, buy nothing, go home light. My mother will ask about the eleven and I will tell her what I told you.

Then I will do the run again in the spring, because the alternative is not doing the run, and thirty families eat off it.
drover anhu tam.appearanceStory: He will return to his mother with twenty-nine cattle and the story of eleven missing; steppe chaps and tassels belong on a weary working drover.

sister arel.name: Sister Arel
sister arel.backstory:
She preserves a measurement that may not be wanted until disaster.

No. It is the nature of a measurement that nobody wants it until they need it. I will have it ready.

What I resent is that Ranger Vane has carried the map down twice and been thanked twice. She is not one of us and she keeps doing our work for us, and that shames me a little.
sister arel.appearanceStory: She preserves a measurement that may not be wanted until disaster; warm wool and fleece carry Whitehorn's patient preparation.

korrin.name: Korrin
korrin.backstory:
He quietly provisions a lone picker whose sister depends on him.

Because he goes alone and one day he will not come back, and the difference is what his sister in the lower village lives on.

If you tell him, I will deny it and I will stop, and neither of us wants that.
korrin.appearanceStory: He quietly provisions a lone picker whose sister depends on him; modest earth colors keep his generosity away from ceremony.

ordinal thrun.name: Ordinal Thrun
ordinal thrun.backstory:
At nineteen he took a beautiful cup from the wall, then returned it and confessed.

A cup. I was nineteen, it was beautiful, it was three feet inside the wall, and I chipped it out over four nights.

It is on the altar now. I put it back and confessed, and they made me Ordinal anyway, twenty years later, because the order does not waste a person who has learned something expensive.
ordinal thrun.appearanceStory: At nineteen he took a beautiful cup from the wall, then returned it and confessed; restrained wool suits an ordinal who knows temptation personally.

brother kell ivorwind.name: Brother Kell Ivorwind
brother kell ivorwind.backstory:
A traveler lost above the snowline remains in his memory.

You have asked, so. A woman, six years ago, four-day tag, went up alone in good weather and did not come down.

We found her on the eighth day, sitting, facing east, above the snowline, with four days of food untouched in her pack and her boots beside her. Not frozen in a huddle. Sitting, and looking at something, and she had taken her boots off to do it.
brother kell ivorwind.appearanceStory: A traveler lost above the snowline remains in his memory; winter wool belongs on the man who measures departures as carefully as arrivals.

mine captain sarra dolt.name: Mine Captain Sarra Dolt
mine captain sarra dolt.backstory:
A resonant blank at the deep face taught her the danger in the mine's stone.

Once, quietly, with a Glasswarden who owed me a favour. We took a blank down to the deep face and struck a resonant crystal beside it.

The blank rang. Not loud - clean, and long, like it had been waiting to. He went white, asked me never to mention he had been here, and I have not, until now.
mine captain sarra dolt.appearanceStory: A resonant blank at the deep face taught her the danger in the mine's stone; patched working layers keep her a crew captain rather than a court officer.

ice-cave sounder vesk.name: Ice-Cave Sounder Vesk
ice-cave sounder vesk.backstory:
The ordinal told him to stop going alone, not to stop listening.

I told Ordinal Thrun. He listened an hour, asked three good questions, and told me to stop going alone.

He did not tell me to stop going. That is the difference between the Votary and everyone else on this lake: they will not tell you your measurement is nonsense until they have taken it themselves.
ice-cave sounder vesk.appearanceStory: The ordinal told him to stop going alone, not to stop listening; reinforced knees and strapped boots suit careful work at the ice face.

cascade watcher ilun.name: Cascade Watcher Ilun
cascade watcher ilun.backstory:
Two hours of watching leave her time to teach herself cairn script.

Extremely. Two hours a day and the rest is mine, and there is nobody within four miles.

I have taught myself the Stoneborn cut-script off the cairns. Badly. Marrow Doun found me at it last spring, corrected my grip without a word, and walked off, and I have not stopped thinking about it since.
cascade watcher ilun.appearanceStory: Two hours of watching leave her time to teach herself cairn script; warm simple wool suits an isolated watcher with a scholar's curiosity.

rope-bridge keeper adhe.name: Rope-Bridge Keeper Adhe
rope-bridge keeper adhe.backstory:
She heard footsteps far out on the boards and kept her lamp down.

Four nights. On the fourth I heard the boards, three spans out, in a wind that should have made that impossible.

I did not put my lamp up. I am not brave and have never claimed to be. But I checked the rope at dawn and there were nine new fibres broken on the upstream side, so somebody was there, and heavy, and quiet.
rope-bridge keeper adhe.appearanceStory: She heard footsteps far out on the boards and kept her lamp down; a trapper coat offers warmth without pretending she is fearless.

shrine sister onwe.name: Shrine Sister Onwe
shrine sister onwe.backstory:
She has kept an anonymous delta sword behind the shrine for nine years.

A sword, nine years ago. Good steel, delta work, no name and no story. It has been in the back of the shrine ever since.

Twice a year I take it out and look at it. Somebody climbed to eight thousand feet in winter to leave a sword and walked away, and either that is the best thing I have ever heard of or the worst, and I cannot tell which.
shrine sister onwe.appearanceStory: She has kept an anonymous delta sword behind the shrine for nine years; warm wool keeps her role hospitable rather than martial.

cairn-reader marrow doun.name: Cairn-Reader Marrow Doun
cairn-reader marrow doun.backstory:
He regrets correcting a self-taught reader instead of teaching her.

Badly. Her grip is wrong and her spacing worse, and she has been at it two years without asking anyone.

I corrected her once. I should have offered to teach her. I have gone back to that cascade three times since and turned around each time, and I am seventy-one years old and I do not know why that is difficult.
cairn-reader marrow doun.appearanceStory: He regrets correcting a self-taught reader instead of teaching her; practical mason's clothes identify the craft he can still share.

ration sister petch.name: Ration Sister Petch
ration sister petch.backstory:
Eleven climbers who did not return still shape her rationing.

Eleven. I can give you the names and I will not, because most have people still living.

The one I think about was a boy of sixteen with six days of food - more than anyone asked of him - who sat down in good weather on an easy slope and did not get up. So the four days are not a promise. They are the part I can control.
ration sister petch.appearanceStory: Eleven climbers who did not return still shape her rationing; fleece and wool belong on someone who measures preparedness in human lives.

snowline ranger kestrel vane.name: Snowline Ranger Kestrel Vane
snowline ranger kestrel vane.backstory:
She carried the order's neglected measurements down to the town because somebody should listen.

Because Sister Arel's order has kept one measurement four hundred years without anybody thanking them, and I found that shaming, and I wanted to be the kind of person who could do that.

Turns out I am not. I am the kind who does it and then gets angry. But I am still doing it, so perhaps the difference does not matter.
snowline ranger kestrel vane.appearanceStory: She carried the order's neglected measurements down to the town because somebody should listen; fur-lined patrol gear fits those long cold journeys.

silverleaf picker doun ashe.name: Silverleaf Picker Doun Ashe
silverleaf picker doun ashe.backstory:
Two falls taught him how little a rope helps without a person at its other end.

Always. Nobody sane will come, and a rope with somebody on the other end is only useful if they can hold you.

I have fallen twice. The first time I caught a bramble and it took nine days to get the thorns out. The second time I caught nothing and landed in a drift, lay there laughing a quarter of an hour, then got up and finished the ledge.
silverleaf picker doun ashe.appearanceStory: Two falls taught him how little a rope helps without a person at its other end; a trapper coat and field-ready lower layers suit his precarious harvest.

ione brass.name: Ione Brass
ione brass.backstory:
Her brother returned from the fence line unable to converse.

Because my brother was a surveyor, and he went inside the fence line to retrieve an instrument, and he came out, and he was never again a person who could hold a conversation.

He is alive. He is at the Observatory. He hums. That is what a careless experiment looks like eleven years later, and I will refuse a licence to anybody, from any region, for any price.
ione brass.appearanceStory: Her brother returned from the fence line unable to converse; luminous calibration cloth marks the investigator who remembers that cost.

varric lens.name: Varric Lens
varric lens.backstory:
At sixty-one he wants his final trading years to rest on honest weights.

No. I am sixty-one, I have three good years of trading left, and I would like to spend them without wondering.

Bring me a shard and I will tell you honestly whether it went through Ammon's table. It costs you nothing and it is the only useful thing I can still do.
varric lens.appearanceStory: At sixty-one he wants his final trading years to rest on honest weights; rich but restrained cloth suits an experienced shard buyer.

observatory warden sela prism.name: Observatory Warden Sela Prism
observatory warden sela prism.backstory:
Naming the vast note under the ground could halt the freight.

That something very large in this ground has begun holding a note, and everything else is being pulled toward it.

If I say that in a licensing hearing, the freight stops, the region starves, and Westhaven simply buys uncalibrated stone from whoever will sell. So I say "within tolerance", go home, and write the real number in my own book.
observatory warden sela prism.appearanceStory: Naming the vast note under the ground could halt the freight; a glowline coat makes her authority visible without a weapon.

tuning adept ollum ghast.name: Tuning Adept Ollum Ghast
tuning adept ollum ghast.backstory:
He wants outsiders to hear the difference between a shard and a calibrated crystal.

I will do better. Bring me a resonant crystal that has been through the Observatory and I will put it in the Ring and let you hear the difference.

Everyone in this region has read the number. Nobody except me has heard it. It is much worse heard.
tuning adept ollum ghast.appearanceStory: He wants outsiders to hear the difference between a shard and a calibrated crystal; tuning clothes and a focus suit a practical demonstrator.

field station cook naia flint.name: Field Station Cook Naia Flint
field station cook naia flint.backstory:
She keeps a slate of fence-line names because her mother's work was never properly recorded.

I am a cook. There is no official for me to say it to.

But I keep a slate in the back with the dates and the names, because my mother worked the fence line before it was fenced, and I know what happens when a region agrees not to look.
field station cook naia flint.appearanceStory: She keeps a slate of fence-line names because her mother's work was never properly recorded; homespun clothing keeps her beside the cookfire.

shard counter bel ammon.name: Shard Counter Bel Ammon
shard counter bel ammon.backstory:
Thirty-one years of two columns are his defense against the coming failure.

Keep counting. I have kept the two columns thirty-one years and I will keep them until somebody takes the book.

When it goes wrong - and it will - the book shows the year it started and the name on every seal. That is not much of a life's work. It is a very good piece of evidence.
shard counter bel ammon.appearanceStory: Thirty-one years of two columns are his defense against the coming failure; violet and linen suit a patient keeper of numerical evidence.

geode digger torvin slate.name: Geode Digger Torvin Slate
geode digger torvin slate.backstory:
He digs unlicensed near the fence where the good rock lies.

I dig where the good rock is and the good rock is near the fence. Everyone knows. Nobody licenses it. So I dig unlicensed and sell to a factor who does not ask.

Before you tell me that is exactly the problem - I know. I have four people on my crew and no other seam. Show me a licensed face that pays and I will move to it tomorrow.
geode digger torvin slate.appearanceStory: He digs unlicensed near the fence where the good rock lies; patched trousers and a bonehook jerkin carry the risk of his trade.

storm-ruin surveyor ash kell.name: Storm-Ruin Surveyor Ash Kell
storm-ruin surveyor ash kell.backstory:
She measures the alternating gaps between old catastrophes.

The gaps between the six are ninety-nine, two hundred and six, ninety-eight, two hundred and eleven, and ninety-seven years. Long, short, long, short, long.

The last was ninety-six years ago and the pattern says short. That is why I look tired, and why I have started counting how tall things are.
storm-ruin surveyor ash kell.appearanceStory: She measures the alternating gaps between old catastrophes; a field tunic and kneepads fit a scholar whose evidence lies outside.

freight factor nils corrow.name: Freight Factor Nils Corrow
freight factor nils corrow.backstory:
A factor who refused cargo lost his livelihood, and Nils has children.

Because I have refused things before. There is a factor in Manymouth who refused a cargo four years ago and is now a clerk in a warehouse counting rope.

I have two children in a Westhaven school. That is not an excuse. I know exactly what it is. I would just rather say it out loud than have you work it out.
freight factor nils corrow.appearanceStory: A factor who refused cargo lost his livelihood, and Nils has children; prosperous colors show the uncomfortable security he is protecting.

watchtower sentinel ivar quill.name: Watchtower Sentinel Ivar Quill
watchtower sentinel ivar quill.backstory:
Three years watching the region be sold a little at a time made him seek an outsider.

Because you are not from here, and because I have stood in this tower three years watching the region be sold a hair at a time.

If you find cause to look into the Observatory's seals, I will confirm every word to anyone who asks. That is all I have. It is more than it sounds like.
watchtower sentinel ivar quill.appearanceStory: Three years watching the region be sold a little at a time made him seek an outsider; plain protective plate fits an alert tower watch.

shard-hauler damu orun.name: Shard-Hauler Damu Orun
shard-hauler damu orun.backstory:
Thirty families depend on wagons carrying something she fears to name.

Because if I say it, the Khanet stops the wagons, thirty families on the salt road eat off the wagons, and Tam is one of them.

So I am waiting for somebody who is not Orun to find out, so it is not me who stopped it. I am not proud of that. You asked.
shard-hauler damu orun.appearanceStory: Thirty families depend on wagons carrying something she fears to name; a fringed kaftan and wrapped trousers suit a long freight road.

cluster warden peri vance.name: Cluster Warden Peri Vance
cluster warden peri vance.backstory:
She restakes a face each week while looking over a vanished valley.

Every week. Then I walk the fence line, which is on my round, and look at four square miles of ground that used to be a valley, and go back and re-stake the face.

Not virtue. I have seen the alternative and it is very large and very quiet.
cluster warden peri vance.appearanceStory: She restakes a face each week while looking over a vanished valley; field clothes suit someone repeatedly confronting what the ground can do.

deaf digger ollo marrow.name: Deaf Digger Ollo Marrow
deaf digger ollo marrow.backstory:
She carries instruments into rock she can no longer hear.

Rock, and readings. Warden Prism gives me a stem instrument, I take it in and bring it back, and she reads it and says nothing.

She has never once told me what it says. I have never once asked. We have had this arrangement four years and it is the closest thing I have to a friendship.
deaf digger ollo marrow.appearanceStory: She carries instruments into rock she can no longer hear; working layers identify the expert whose usefulness outlasted her hearing.

elder sura.name: Elder Sura
elder sura.backstory:
Her brother must move a people only on proof, not rumor.

My brother will do what the banner requires, which is nothing until somebody proves something. That is not weakness. A khan who moves on a rumour moves eleven hundred people on a rumour.

But Berel is impatient and the Khanet is not wrong to be. If somebody brings a measured fact off that eastern ground, the banner will move within a week.
elder sura.appearanceStory: Her brother must move a people only on proof, not rumor; a dignified fringed kaftan carries a camp elder's authority.

kesh.name: Kesh
kesh.backstory:
He would rather be owed by a living camp than paid by a dead one.

To all four, unwritten, and Judge Bakhan would rule it a gift rather than a debt if it ever came to that.

Fine. I would rather be owed by a camp that is standing than paid by one that is not.
kesh.appearanceStory: He would rather be owed by a living camp than paid by a dead one; simple trade colors fit a creditor who treats survival as good business.

orun khan.name: Orun khan
orun khan.backstory:
He demands a reading neither people can dismiss before moving the herds.

A reading taken with a Glasswarden instrument, on Orun ground, by somebody neither of us can accuse.

Berel has asked the Barrens twice. Both surveyors returned within tolerance and went home. I would accept a reading from a stranger over a courtesy from a neighbour, and that is a shameful thing for a khan to have to say.
orun khan.appearanceStory: He demands a reading neither people can dismiss before moving the herds; bone-clasp ceremonial layers declare responsibility rather than haste.

seasonal market broker.name: Seasonal market broker
seasonal market broker.backstory:
Four markets taught her to recognize a nameless factor who buys only information.

A Westhaven factor with no name, four years running, who buys nothing and talks to everybody.

I have watched him work three markets. He is not buying. He is finding out who will sell what when they are desperate, and he is very good, and I recognise it because it is what I do.
seasonal market broker.appearanceStory: Four markets taught her to recognize a nameless factor who buys only information; bright market cloth fits a trader who watches the watchers.

camp horse master.name: Camp horse master
camp horse master.backstory:
She moved the horses west before anyone would announce the bad grazing.

Moved them west and said nothing, because a horse master who says the eastern grazing is bad is a horse master telling eleven hundred people to move.

That is the Khan's word to say, not mine. But if somebody asked me under guest-right, at a fire, with the Judge present, I would say it.
camp horse master.appearanceStory: She moved the horses west before anyone would announce the bad grazing; practical steppe chaps show where her authority is earned.

west caravan master.name: West caravan master
west caravan master.backstory:
She waters at the third well and calls the detour grazing.

I do. What else is there.

But I water at the third and not the fourth now, which adds half a day, and I have told my drivers it is for the grazing. It is not for the grazing.
west caravan master.appearanceStory: She waters at the third well and calls the detour grazing; a fringed traveling kaftan suits a captain protecting drivers without an explanation.

east caravan master.name: East caravan master
east caravan master.backstory:
She hopes the troubling hum belongs to the ground rather than her cargo.

I think it is the ground and not the cargo, and I think that because I need it to be.

That is an honest answer and the only one I have. Rider Dur stops his wagon a mile short of camp now and walks in. He has not told me why and I have not asked, and both of those are decisions.
east caravan master.appearanceStory: She hopes the troubling hum belongs to the ground rather than her cargo; a rider vest keeps her dressed for the route she must still travel.

banner shrine keeper.name: Banner shrine keeper
banner shrine keeper.backstory:
The stone remains the record after a banner falls.

The banner comes down and the stone stays, and the stone is the record.

Harun Tel filled a well this season and did not take the banner down. It stands over nothing, nine hundred paces east of the salt track, and I have not asked him about it, because I know Harun and he will tell me when he can.
banner shrine keeper.appearanceStory: The stone remains the record after a banner falls; a red sash connects her shrine duty to the camp's living signs.

steppe miller.name: Steppe miller
steppe miller.backstory:
She knows the contract writer delays a harmful bargain and has never thanked him.

Yes, and Tallyman Corrin knows how and will not say. He is Greyhaven, he writes the contracts, and he has been slow about it for six years on purpose.

I have never thanked him and he has never admitted it. We nod. That is the entire arrangement.
steppe miller.appearanceStory: She knows the contract writer delays a harmful bargain and has never thanked him; patched work cloth belongs amid flour and daily dependence.

crossroads well keeper.name: Crossroads well keeper
crossroads well keeper.backstory:
He gives guest-right even to a man who refuses his name.

A Westhaven factor, four times in two years, who eats and will not give a name, which is permitted and not done.

Under guest-right a nameless guest is still a guest. I have fed him four times and written "unnamed, Westhaven seal" four times, and Bakhan has read it four times and said nothing, which from Bakhan means a great deal.
crossroads well keeper.appearanceStory: He gives guest-right even to a man who refuses his name; wrapped traveling clothes suit a host at a shared water source.

barrow warden.name: Barrow warden
barrow warden.backstory:
He keeps both herds and diggers away from old deposits.

Keep the herds off them and the diggers off them, and there are more diggers than herds these days.

Debt-Reader Pell on the Grey Moors keeps a list of every barrow in Nymara. Hers has three hundred and eleven. She does not know about my four. Somebody should tell her and I cannot write.
barrow warden.appearanceStory: He keeps both herds and diggers away from old deposits; a rider vest gives the steppe watch freedom of movement.

cove landing factor.name: Cove landing factor
cove landing factor.backstory:
Four sealed night cargoes paid an office instead of her fee.

One cargo, four times in two years. Sealed crates going out, not coming in, loaded at night, fee paid to the Khanet's office rather than to me.

I have never seen a fee paid past me. I did not complain, because complaining means asking what is in the crates, and I decided I would rather have the nine days.
cove landing factor.appearanceStory: Four sealed night cargoes paid an office instead of her fee; formal trading colors suit a factor whose useful knowledge came from exclusion.

dune well keeper.name: Dune well keeper
dune well keeper.backstory:
Nine keepers have water measurements but cannot carry them away in writing.

Easily. Nine keepers, nine numbers, one afternoon, and none of us can write and none of us leaves our well.

Somebody who walked the southern line asking nine people one question would have the best water record on this steppe by nightfall. I have been waiting eleven years for that person.
dune well keeper.appearanceStory: Nine keepers have water measurements but cannot carry them away in writing; pale wrapped cloth suits a keeper exposed to sand and sun.

salt-pan factor.name: Salt-pan factor
salt-pan factor.backstory:
Rising salt yields have begun to worry him instead of delight him.

The yield is up. Nine per cent, two years running, and I should be pleased.

Salt yield rises when the water evaporates faster or when there is less water to start with. Nobody has asked me which and I have not volunteered, because the answer is that the southern wells are dropping and I would rather be the man with the good harvest.
salt-pan factor.appearanceStory: Rising salt yields have begun to worry him instead of delight him; pale work cloth keeps the business grounded in the drying pans.

wind caves watch.name: Wind caves watch
wind caves watch.backstory:
A midwinter singing in the fourth chamber left him loyal to the caves.

To the fourth chamber once, for the midwinter singing, with forty other people. The most beautiful thing I have ever heard.

Listener Esku says the caves have sounded on nights with no wind. I was there for one of them. Outside, alone, and it sounded, and I have never told anybody in the camp because I would have to explain why I did not go in.
wind caves watch.appearanceStory: A midwinter singing in the fourth chamber left him loyal to the caves; mobile steppe gear suits the watch outside their echoing mouths.

amethyst prospector.name: Amethyst prospector
amethyst prospector.backstory:
He sells shards back toward the region they came from and has begun to question the buyer.

A factor who buys at the salt track, gives no name, pays cash at the wagon, and takes it east sealed.

East is the Barrens, which is where it came from. Somebody buys Barrens stone on Orun ground so it can enter the Barrens as steppe goods with no count against it. I worked that out in my second season and I have kept selling, and you may draw whatever conclusion you like.
amethyst prospector.appearanceStory: He sells shards back toward the region they came from and has begun to question the buyer; patched field layers suit an itinerant digger.

whitehorn range warden.name: Whitehorn range warden
whitehorn range warden.backstory:
She asked for the snowline map because northern wells drink the same thaw.

That the melt is early and getting earlier, and that this steppe drinks the same melt in its northern wells.

Ranger Vane has a map nobody wants. I have asked her for a copy twice. She has said yes twice and forgotten twice, and I do not blame her, because I am the fourth person in nine years to ask her for anything at all.
whitehorn range warden.appearanceStory: She asked for the snowline map because northern wells drink the same thaw; fur-lined patrol clothes carry that mountain connection onto the steppe.

khanet berel suran.name: Khanet Berel Suran
khanet berel suran.backstory:
She needs impartial readings before she can protect an entire camp.

A reading. Not a rumour, not a dead foal - a number taken with a Glasswarden instrument on Orun ground by somebody neither of us can accuse of lying.

I have asked the Barrens twice for a survey. Twice they sent a surveyor who returned within tolerance and went home. I would like a third opinion from somebody who is not for sale.
khanet berel suran.appearanceStory: She needs impartial readings before she can protect an entire camp; a bone-clasp coat gives her authority a working, local form.

herd-mother tamu ashai.name: Herd-Mother Tamu Ashai
herd-mother tamu ashai.backstory:
When nothing can save a dying foal she stays beside it.

I sit with them. That is the whole answer. There is nothing to be done and there is somebody to be with.

Doctor Nesrin came out and looked at four and found nothing wrong, and she cried, which I did not expect from a lakeside woman. I have thought better of the lake ever since.
herd-mother tamu ashai.appearanceStory: When nothing can save a dying foal she stays beside it; tasselled layers and steppe chaps suit the person who remains with the herd.

salt rider onen dur.name: Salt Rider Onen Dur
salt rider onen dur.backstory:
He parks his humming wagon a mile from camp and walks in.

I sleep four hours a night and I have a wagon that hums. Yes, it worries me.

I have started stopping the wagon a mile short of camp and walking in, so the crates spend the night away from the herd. Nobody told me to. I have not told anybody I do it.
salt rider onen dur.appearanceStory: He parks his humming wagon a mile from camp and walks in; riding gear belongs on a freight worker already changing his habits.

banner boy suvi.name: Banner Boy Suvi
banner boy suvi.backstory:
He wears the banner his absent sister once carried and worries about her letters.

My sister had it. She went east with a wagon train two years ago to see the Barrens and has not come back, and she writes, and the letters are fine, and they do not sound like her.

Judge Bakhan says letters never sound like people. I have read them to him. He said that, then read them again himself, and did not say anything else.
banner boy suvi.appearanceStory: He wears the banner his absent sister once carried and worries about her letters; a red rider's layer keeps that inherited duty visible.

wind-cave listener esku.name: Wind-Cave Listener Esku
wind-cave listener esku.backstory:
Her nine dates agree with a reader beneath the caves on seven occasions.

Tul Marrow, who reads the echoes inside the caves and has her own list. My list and hers agree on seven of nine dates.

Nobody else. The Khanet listened politely. The Barrens told me the caves are outside their survey area, which is true and is the single most Glasswarden sentence I have ever heard.
wind-cave listener esku.appearanceStory: Her nine dates agree with a reader beneath the caves on seven occasions; knee-protected work clothes fit evidence gathered by patient listening.

well-digger harun tel.name: Well-Digger Harun Tel
well-digger harun tel.backstory:
He keeps quiet about the hum because thousands of animals need the well.

Because the eastern grazing has three wells and two thousand animals and no alternative until autumn, and if I say the word "hum" the camp moves and the herd starves on the way.

I have told you and nobody else. If somebody with instruments wants to open it again, it is nine hundred paces east of the salt track under a cairn I built badly on purpose.
well-digger harun tel.appearanceStory: He keeps quiet about the hum because thousands of animals need the well; ropecoil gear makes the water worker recognizable.

caravan doctor nesrin.name: Caravan Doctor Nesrin
caravan doctor nesrin.backstory:
Two seasons studying steppe fever became eleven years among the herds.

I came for two seasons, eleven years ago, to write a paper on steppe fevers. The paper is not finished.

Herd-Mother Ashai sat with a dying foal six hours because there was nobody else to be with it, and I stood there being useless, and I understood I had never in my life seen anybody do that. So I stayed.
caravan doctor nesrin.appearanceStory: Two seasons studying steppe fever became eleven years among the herds; ivory and a clear red accent make the doctor easy to seek out.

guest-right judge oru bakhan.name: Guest-Right Judge Oru Bakhan
guest-right judge oru bakhan.backstory:
A boy's letters made him doubt his own reassuring answer.

The boy brought me her letters and asked whether they sounded like her. I said letters never do.

Then I read them myself. She writes about the Barrens with the enthusiasm of a person describing a room they have not entered. Nine letters, no smells, no food, no names. I have not told him. I have written to the Barrens twice and had no reply.
guest-right judge oru bakhan.appearanceStory: A boy's letters made him doubt his own reassuring answer; formal sashwork suits a judge who still reads before he rules.

grain tallyman sef corrin.name: Grain Tallyman Sef Corrin
grain tallyman sef corrin.backstory:
A childhood in a flour-poor attic makes him quietly obstruct unfair contracts.

Because I grew up in a Westhaven attic on flour my mother could not afford, and I know exactly which end of this arrangement I am on.

I am not brave enough to leave. I am just careless enough to be slow. It is a very small rebellion and it is the one I have.
grain tallyman sef corrin.appearanceStory: A childhood in a flour-poor attic makes him quietly obstruct unfair contracts; plain linen keeps the tallyman close to the people who pay for them.

eryn amber.name: Eryn Amber
eryn amber.backstory:
Nineteen undefeated years representing the estate coexist with its troubling day books.

Mine, obviously, and mine happens to be the estate's. I have been the Amber nineteen years and I have never lost a case.

But I have read the estate's own day books back four generations, and there are entries paying Mycelari crews for work in that coppice, signed by my predecessors. That is not remembering. That is a receipt. And a receipt is a document, and documents are the one thing everybody here agrees to argue with.
eryn amber.appearanceStory: Nineteen undefeated years representing the estate coexist with its troubling day books; formal gold-and-plum dress expresses that compromised standing.

tomas root.name: Tomas Root
tomas root.backstory:
He reads crew tally sticks that prove old paid work on the land.

Tally sticks. A crew's work record - one notch a day, one stick a season, four sticks.

Which means somebody was paying that crew and somebody was counting the days. Not a receipt. But a receipt has to be written by somebody, and a tally stick is what the person being paid keeps.
tomas root.appearanceStory: He reads crew tally sticks that prove old paid work on the land; rootwrap garments carry the woodland labor at the heart of his evidence.

warden of the amber gate.name: Warden of the Amber Gate
warden of the amber gate.backstory:
She records refugees' roads and hears what they leave behind.

Six to Westhaven and three to Four Gates, and I know because I write the road down and they told me, because people tell a gate warden things.

Every one of the nine was a coppice worker. Not tappers, not burners - coppice. They are not emigrating. They are being outlasted, one household a season, and my count is the only place in Nymara it is written down.
warden of the amber gate.appearanceStory: She records refugees' roads and hears what they leave behind; a studded jack gives a gatekeeper practical protection without concealing her face.

hall steward.name: Hall Steward
hall steward.backstory:
A laundry search exposed her ancestor's coppice pay in an estate book.

One volume, once, by accident, looking for a laundry account. The year my great-grandfather's crew was paid for coppice work.

His name is in it. Greyhaven name, Mycelari crew, same page. I put the volume back and I have not slept as well since.
hall steward.appearanceStory: A laundry search exposed her ancestor's coppice pay in an estate book; plum service cloth reflects household duty complicated by family history.

amber master.name: Amber Master
amber master.backstory:
Someone along his resin accounts altered the returns.

I do not know and that is the part that has kept me awake. Returns go from my desk to the Hall to the harbour to a hull, and any hand on that road could have done it.

What I do know is that both times the words were struck with a straight edge and re-inked in a hand that matched mine well enough to pass a clerk. Somebody in this forest can write like me and has taken the trouble to learn.
amber master.appearanceStory: Someone along his resin accounts altered the returns; prosperous workday colors mark a trade expert unable to sleep over the discrepancy.

resin trader.name: Resin Trader
resin trader.backstory:
Forward buyers keep paying last year's price for next year's declining resin.

The Westhaven yard for hull seams, and a house factor who buys forward - pays now for next year's barrels at this year's price.

Four years running. If the yield keeps falling he loses badly, and he does not strike me as a man who loses badly, which means he knows something about next year that I do not.
resin trader.appearanceStory: Forward buyers keep paying last year's price for next year's declining resin; amber earth colors suit a trader dependent on living trees.

harbour master.name: Harbour Master
harbour master.backstory:
A declaring hull keeps returning from the wrong direction.

One hull, four times a year, taking on resin, declaring for Westhaven, and returning from the north-east, which is not where Westhaven is.

Reeve Stell at the quarry says her stone goes the same way. Two of us have noticed and neither has anybody to tell.
harbour master.appearanceStory: A declaring hull keeps returning from the wrong direction; rope workwear fits an official whose evidence comes from watching actual boats.

timber reeve.name: Timber Reeve
timber reeve.backstory:
Eleven years in a Westhaven yard taught her that lawful full-depth cutting can still be wrong.

Because I served eleven years in a Westhaven yard before this and I have seen what full-depth coppicing does to a stand in four cycles.

My order is lawful and it is wrong. So I keep the order, and I keep Renn, and I write "yields light, stools poor" every quarter, and one day somebody will audit the stools and I will be finished.
timber reeve.appearanceStory: Eleven years in a Westhaven yard taught her that lawful full-depth cutting can still be wrong; a bark jerkin places her in the worked forest.

charcoal burner.name: Charcoal Burner
charcoal burner.backstory:
Long waits at four in the morning make him an accidental watcher of the eastern column.

Everything, at four in the morning, badly. The only trade in Nymara that is nine-tenths waiting.

And I watch the column east of the Ash Gate, the one Scout Kite reports. It is a burn. I would swear to it. Four days on, three days off, and nobody in that country has any wood.
charcoal burner.appearanceStory: Long waits at four in the morning make him an accidental watcher of the eastern column; patched clothing suits a soot-stained waiting trade.

canopy rigger.name: Canopy Rigger
canopy rigger.backstory:
Forty feet up, the rope makers' common trust matters more than speeches.

Every day, forty feet up, on rope they taught us to lay. Then I come down, the Warden says the words about common trust, and I go home.

Up there nobody has ever once mentioned a deed. I have started to think the whole argument is a ground-level phenomenon.
canopy rigger.appearanceStory: Forty feet up, the rope makers' common trust matters more than speeches; ropecoil garments put that skill into her outline.

keeper of the hollow.name: Keeper of the Hollow
keeper of the hollow.backstory:
Bundles, resin and grass knots keep arriving at the hollow.

No. Four or five times a year I find things left in it - a bundle of leaves, a knot of grass, a smear of resin on the inner wall.

Cutter Renn finds the same on his stumps. I have never told him and he has never told me, and we both know, and neither wants to be the one who reports it.
keeper of the hollow.appearanceStory: Bundles, resin and grass knots keep arriving at the hollow; rootwrap cloth suits a keeper of signs that are not ordinary offerings.

garden warden.name: Garden Warden
garden warden.backstory:
He grows what will survive this far north and worries about the Stair's antidote.

Physick. Everything Tessara's garden on the Verdant Stair grows that will survive this far north, which is about a third of it.

If the Stair ever stops making antidote - and Physick Thal says it might - somebody on this lake needs to already have the plants. That is not estate policy. That is me and a trowel.
garden warden.appearanceStory: He grows what will survive this far north and worries about the Stair's antidote; rootwork clothing belongs beside a medicinal garden.

ash scout.name: Ash Scout
ash scout.backstory:
Twice he walked toward the column and found a cold, carefully closed burn.

Twice. Once out of curiosity and once because I saw the column and wanted to know.

Nothing there. Ash, and a hollow where a burn had been, cold, with the turf stacked beside it the way a burner stacks it. Somebody is making charcoal in a place with no wood and I put "no change" in the book.
ash scout.appearanceStory: Twice he walked toward the column and found a cold, carefully closed burn; a scout vest suits watchfulness earned out on the ground.

north watcher.name: North Watcher
north watcher.backstory:
Four night wagons a season taught him a nine-day northern pattern.

Wagons that do not stop. Four a season, at night, going north with a load and coming back light in nine days.

Nine days north is the Whitehorn mine road. There is nothing this forest needs from a mine and nothing a mine needs from this forest, and yet somebody has run that route for six years.
north watcher.appearanceStory: Four night wagons a season taught him a nine-day northern pattern; practical scouting layers dress the observer at the road edge.

hamlet elder.name: Hamlet Elder
hamlet elder.backstory:
Twenty-two years of uncollected water bills keep a village's claim alive.

No. They take it, I write down that they took it, and once a year I send the estate a bill for water I have never collected and never will.

Twenty-two years of that. If anybody ever wants documentary evidence that this forest was shared before it was deeded, it is in a drawer in my kitchen and it is nine inches thick.
hamlet elder.appearanceStory: Twenty-two years of uncollected water bills keep a village's claim alive; simple pale civic cloth suits stubborn local stewardship.

wayshrine hermit.name: Wayshrine Hermit
wayshrine hermit.backstory:
People speak over her and accidentally tell the truth.

Everything, because people talk over a hermit the way they talk over a dog.

The most interesting thing in four years was a Westhaven surveyor singing an estate song from before the deeds, correctly, alone, in the rain, when he thought there was nobody there. There was somebody there.
wayshrine hermit.appearanceStory: People speak over her and accidentally tell the truth; unshowy pilgrimage clothes make room for the quiet witness at the road.

motherroot voice sillow.name: Motherroot Voice Sillow
motherroot voice sillow.backstory:
She seeks the receipts that would prove her people's paid labor.

The receipts. Eryn Amber knows they exist and will not produce them, because producing them costs her estate a case it has already won.

I am not asking anyone to believe what we remember. I am asking somebody to go into the Amber Hall's day books and find the four entries where her great-grandfather paid my great-grandmother for that coppice. Then it is a document, and then we can argue like everybody else.
motherroot voice sillow.appearanceStory: She seeks the receipts that would prove her people's paid labor; ivory-vine regalia connects public dignity with the old living grove.

spore-elder tamm hollow.name: Spore-Elder Tamm Hollow
spore-elder tamm hollow.backstory:
His fifth planting finally rooted an abandoned wet stand.

A stand of eleven trees in the wet corner that would not take. She replanted it four times in nine years.

Twelve years ago I planted it a fifth time and it took. I have never told anybody, because the only person who would have understood has been dead ninety years and is also, in a way no notary will accept, standing right here.
