spore-elder tamm hollow.appearanceStory: His fifth planting finally rooted an abandoned wet stand; vine garments suit an elder whose claim rests in patient successful growing.

grove reader nesh pallid.name: Grove Reader Nesh Pallid
grove reader nesh pallid.backstory:
She links the forest's old scar to dates in the eastern storm ruins.

I do not know. East is the Barrens, two hundred and eleven years ago, and Surveyor Kell's storm ruins are dated in a band that includes that year.

I wrote to her. She wrote back four pages and one question I cannot answer: was the scarring on the west face only, or was the wood behind it cooked? To tell her I would have to core one of the twelve, and coring a deep grove tree is not a thing my people do.
grove reader nesh pallid.appearanceStory: She links the forest's old scar to dates in the eastern storm ruins; rootwrap layers place the reader between memory and investigation.

coppice cutter aldo renn.name: Coppice Cutter Aldo Renn
coppice cutter aldo renn.backstory:
After twenty-two years he began cutting shallower than ordered.

I have cut twenty-two years and never once felt like a vandal until this season.

I have started cutting shallower than the reeve orders. Costs the yard a ninth of the yield and nobody has noticed. If somebody does, I will say the stools were poor. That is a lie and I am going to keep telling it.
coppice cutter aldo renn.appearanceStory: After twenty-two years he began cutting shallower than ordered; a bark jerkin belongs on the cutter taking a smaller yield to spare a stand.

wayshrine cantor ivy marl.name: Wayshrine Cantor Ivy Marl
wayshrine cantor ivy marl.backstory:
Twice in eleven years she wanted to sing her own weather into the ground and refused.

Never. A cantor who sings her own verses puts her own weather into the ground, and there is enough of that already.

Twice in eleven years I have wanted to. Once when my sister went into the deep grove and did not come back, and once last month, when I understood why the surveyor knew that song.
wayshrine cantor ivy marl.appearanceStory: Twice in eleven years she wanted to sing her own weather into the ground and refused; pale vine regalia suits that ritual restraint.

orchard keeper bess torrow.name: Orchard Keeper Bess Torrow
orchard keeper bess torrow.backstory:
Rejected reports taught her to write the accepted yield numbers instead.

I have tried twice. Both reports came back with "unquantified" written on them in a very neat hand.

So now I write the yield figures, which they like, and not where they came from. Everyone gets what they want and the trees do not care who takes the credit.
orchard keeper bess torrow.appearanceStory: Rejected reports taught her to write the accepted yield numbers instead; rootwork cloth keeps a meticulous observer among the fruit trees.

skep-keeper runa combe.name: Skep-Keeper Runa Combe
skep-keeper runa combe.backstory:
She asks someone to count flight directions for three days and remembers who stayed for two.

To anybody who will stand in a field three days and count directions. That is what it costs. Nobody has ever been willing.

Bess Torrow did, last spring, for two days, and then had to see to her orchard. Those two days are the closest anyone from the league has come to looking at our evidence.
skep-keeper runa combe.appearanceStory: She asks someone to count flight directions for three days and remembers who stayed for two; warm gold workwear belongs beside her skeps.

cinder chaplain osric vane.name: Cinder Chaplain Osric Vane
cinder chaplain osric vane.backstory:
Nine predecessors' notebooks taught him how hope slowly becomes routine.

Nine chaplains. I have read all nine and I can tell you the exact sentence where each of them stopped expecting anything to happen.

Mine is on the third page and it reads "the field is unchanged". I wrote that for eleven years before I bothered to measure, and my predecessor's measurement was in the book the whole time. I am the ninth man to sit here and the first in four to do arithmetic, and I am not proud of the eleven years.
cinder chaplain osric vane.appearanceStory: Nine predecessors' notebooks taught him how hope slowly becomes routine; a modest acolyte layer suits a chaplain still keeping the record.

quarry reeve dunna stell.name: Quarry Reeve Dunna Stell
quarry reeve dunna stell.backstory:
Her uncle died on a face he had warned was rotten, and she cut his name herself.

My mother's brother, nineteen years ago, on a face he had told the reeve was rotten. The reeve of the day was a league appointment with a schedule.

I cut the name myself. It took four days and I did it badly on purpose, so it is the ugliest name on that face and everyone asks about it. That was the point.
quarry reeve dunna stell.appearanceStory: Her uncle died on a face he had warned was rotten, and she cut his name herself; kneepads dress a reeve who measures stone in losses.

ridge scout tarrow kite.name: Ridge Scout Tarrow Kite
ridge scout tarrow kite.backstory:
He stopped a mile from the strange column and hides his fear in a careful report.

To within a mile. Then I stopped, and I have never been able to make myself explain why, and I have been on this ridge fourteen years.

I put it in the report as "unattributed column, east". The reeve has not asked. I check for it every single morning and it has never once not been there.
ridge scout tarrow kite.appearanceStory: He stopped a mile from the strange column and hides his fear in a careful report; a scout vest keeps him a road worker rather than a hero in plate.

kelp landing factor hesper.name: Kelp Landing Factor Hesper
kelp landing factor hesper.backstory:
She absorbed a reduced volume after Sillow asked a single polite favor.

Because I make my living on volume and a ninth is survivable, and because Sillow at the Motherroot asked me, once, very politely, not to.

I have never been asked a favour by a Mycelari before. It cost me nothing and it has bothered me for two years, which suggests I got the worse end of it.
kelp landing factor hesper.appearanceStory: She absorbed a reduced volume after Sillow asked a single polite favor; subdued green trading cloth reflects business moderated by an obligation.

nine watchers hermit bode.name: Nine Watchers Hermit Bode
nine watchers hermit bode.backstory:
His line has kept the stones for eleven centuries without knowing why.

Because somebody in my line has lived at these stones without a break for eleven hundred years, and I am the one who is it.

We do not know why either. There is a duty and there is nobody left who remembers what it is for, and I am not about to be the first to put it down.
nine watchers hermit bode.appearanceStory: His line has kept the stones for eleven centuries without knowing why; spare pilgrim dress respects a duty older than its explanation.

mora fen.name: Mora Fen
mora fen.backstory:
She has watched pale moorlights dozens of times and remembers the one that approached.

Ninety times, perhaps. Not a story. A pale moving light over the peat, mostly on still nights, mostly near an opened barrow.

Once - once - one came to the boards where I was standing and stopped four feet away for a slow count of nine, and then went. I have thought about those nine seconds every day for six years.
mora fen.appearanceStory: She has watched pale moorlights dozens of times and remembers the one that approached; plum and earth colors fit a grounded witness to the strange.

pell wick.name: Pell Wick
pell wick.backstory:
A request to testify about his grandfather's peat cut still troubles him.

Once, and not by a light. By Speaker Hurn, who stopped me on the road eleven years ago and asked whether I would testify about a barrow my grandfather cut peat over.

I said no. I have thought about it every year since. He has never asked again and has never been anything but civil, and I would rather he had shouted.
pell wick.appearanceStory: A request to testify about his grandfather's peat cut still troubles him; patched workwear carries the family trade beside its unfinished obligation.

barrow warden cassa loom.name: Barrow Warden Cassa Loom
barrow warden cassa loom.backstory:
A well-closed emptied chamber has made her question inherited decisions.

I think a chamber was emptied and closed, the closing was done well enough that a chain cannot find it, and somebody four generations back thought that was the right thing to do.

Sexton Coombe has the crypt keys and knows things he will not say to a Greyhaven. Speaker Hurn will not speak to me at all. Eleven years here and I am still the outsider who put stakes in.
barrow warden cassa loom.appearanceStory: A well-closed emptied chamber has made her question inherited decisions; dark wool suits the careful keeper of other people's remains.

stone-court speaker hurn.name: Stone-Court Speaker Hurn
stone-court speaker hurn.backstory:
He cannot open a case himself and waits for someone who can state the deposit.

The court cannot open a case. The court can only hear one that is brought.

Anyone may bring one. Any person, of any people, who can state the deposit, the depositor and the breach. Nobody has in four hundred years, and I have sat on this stone thirty-one waiting.
stone-court speaker hurn.appearanceStory: He cannot open a case himself and waits for someone who can state the deposit; formal pale cloth identifies judgment rather than force.

peat reeve ollam skarr.name: Peat Reeve Ollam Skarr
peat reeve ollam skarr.backstory:
He secretly returns half the deposits and records them as damaged.

I log them. I send about half. The other half I take to Debt-Reader Pell, who writes them in her list and puts them back in the ground, and I write "damaged, discarded" in the day book.

If Westhaven ever audits me I am finished. Six years of it and I have never once wanted to stop.
peat reeve ollam skarr.appearanceStory: He secretly returns half the deposits and records them as damaged; patched field clothes suit a working reeve shielding the ground from his own office.

debt-reader maun pell.name: Debt-Reader Maun Pell
debt-reader maun pell.backstory:
Nine years comparing lights to breached barrows have made her list something more than an account.

The lights. Not every night, not predictably, but always near a breached barrow and never near a whole one. I have checked that against my list for nine years and it has never failed.

And they have walked every night this month, which has never happened, which means either a twelfth has been breached or one of the eleven has finally run out of patience.
debt-reader maun pell.appearanceStory: Nine years comparing lights to breached barrows have made her list something more than an account; rootwrap clothing ties the reader to living memory.

crypt sexton ivar coombe.name: Crypt Sexton Ivar Coombe
crypt sexton ivar coombe.backstory:
Unproven visits to a newly bare floor keep him watching his chambers.

Nothing I can prove. They go in light and come out light, and they are down there about two hours.

But the eleventh chamber has a floor that used to be flagged and is now bare earth, and somebody lifted forty flags and stacked them neatly against a wall, and nobody does that in the dark for nothing.
crypt sexton ivar coombe.appearanceStory: Unproven visits to a newly bare floor keep him watching his chambers; dark wool dresses custody without a claim of martial power.

moorlight watcher sisi farrow.name: Moorlight Watcher Sisi Farrow
moorlight watcher sisi farrow.backstory:
Nine nights of the same light passing her door have cost her sleep.

Every night for the last nine. The same route, past my door, four feet from the step.

I have stopped sleeping. I have stopped going out. And the worst of it is that I do not think it is coming for me at all - I think my house stands on the shortest line between the eighth barrow and the Great Barrow, and I am in the way of an errand.
moorlight watcher sisi farrow.appearanceStory: Nine nights of the same light passing her door have cost her sleep; muted violet cloth suits a frightened witness keeping close to home.

pony drover teg halloran.name: Pony Drover Teg Halloran
pony drover teg halloran.backstory:
A daylight bet across a barrow road taught him fear without a visible cause.

Once, on foot, on a bet, twenty years ago. Forty yards, in daylight, with nine people watching.

Nothing happened. Nothing at all. And I got to the other side so frightened I could not speak, and I still cannot tell you of what. The ponies were right and I do not know what they were right about.
pony drover teg halloran.appearanceStory: A daylight bet across a barrow road taught him fear without a visible cause; traveling chaps belong on a drover who trusts his ponies' routes.

bog-iron smith nella doust.name: Bog-Iron Smith Nella Doust
bog-iron smith nella doust.backstory:
She has nine nodules saved for a commission with a line, term and reason.

If somebody brought a proper commission - a line, a term, a reason - I would make it and I would not sleep for a week beforehand.

I have the nodules put by. Nine of them, my grandmother's, taken from under the Great Barrow before the fencing. She kept them forty years and did not make anything either.
bog-iron smith nella doust.appearanceStory: She has nine nodules saved for a commission with a line, term and reason; patched forge cloth and protected feet fit her exacting craft.

orchid gatherer wenna slee.name: Orchid Gatherer Wenna Slee
orchid gatherer wenna slee.backstory:
Her mother taught her to name the barrow stone before taking one flower.

I name the stone before I cut. Out loud. Whatever is on the mouth I read it and say it, then take one flower and leave the rest.

My mother taught me that. I asked her once whether it did anything. She said she had no idea and that she had never been troubled on the moor at night, and neither have I.
orchid gatherer wenna slee.appearanceStory: Her mother taught her to name the barrow stone before taking one flower; rootwork layers keep the gatherer's reverence practical.

standing-stone mason colm rethe.name: Standing-Stone Mason Colm Rethe
standing-stone mason colm rethe.backstory:
At seventy-four he has recut two hundred stones but left eleven untouched.

Nothing, and I am seventy-four. I have recut two hundred stones in my life and those eleven I have left exactly as they are, and I could not have told you why until Pell showed me her list.

If somebody wants to know what a blank return field means, the person to ask is the court, and the court cannot open a case, and I have known that thirty years and never once brought one.
standing-stone mason colm rethe.appearanceStory: At seventy-four he has recut two hundred stones but left eleven untouched; work-worn knee protection belongs on a lifetime stone cutter.

moor chandler perrin wisk.name: Moor Chandler Perrin Wisk
moor chandler perrin wisk.backstory:
He sleeps on roads his ponies know avoid barrows and sells relief from the dark.

Two. And I sleep in the cart on the road between villages, because the road is never on a barrow line - Halloran's ponies taught me that.

I have made my living off other people's fear eleven years and I would like it on record that I am just as frightened and I charge myself the same price.
moor chandler perrin wisk.appearanceStory: He sleeps on roads his ponies know avoid barrows and sells relief from the dark; a buckled coat suits a traveling lamp supplier.

captain iven.name: Captain Iven
captain iven.backstory:
He needs a notary's oath to challenge a house seal and knows who might give it.

Because to open a house seal I need a Guild notary to swear the seal is misused, and every notary in Westhaven is paid by a house.

Elber Wisk would do it. He has said so, in private, twice. What he needs is a document he did not produce himself, from outside the league, that he can hold up. Bring him one and this city changes in a fortnight.
captain iven.appearanceStory: He needs a notary's oath to challenge a house seal and knows who might give it; polished civic armor dresses a captain constrained by law.

sela quay.name: Sela Quay
sela quay.backstory:
She stores the crates of displaced people without expiry.

It waits. Civic storage does not expire, which was a rule made for merchants and has turned out to be a rule about refugees.

Nine hundred crates belonging to people with no channel to go back to. Cantor Tem-Ossa in the delta sings them out and writes the channel on a wall. I keep the crates. Between us we are the entire record of what happened to those families.
sela quay.appearanceStory: She stores the crates of displaced people without expiry; simple green civic clothes fit a keeper treating storage as refuge.

harbour reeve anselm coy.name: Harbour Reeve Anselm Coy
harbour reeve anselm coy.backstory:
He has begun walking his own letters past the Factor's House to the ferry.

I do not know. The hall's outgoing post goes through the Factor's House and has for six years, on grounds of efficiency.

I have started walking my own letters to the ferry. It costs me an hour a week and has made a great many people irritable, which I take as confirmation.
harbour reeve anselm coy.appearanceStory: He has begun walking his own letters past the Factor's House to the ferry; neat navy clothes suit an administrator forced to do his own errands.

crane foreman bettis roke.name: Crane Foreman Bettis Roke
crane foreman bettis roke.backstory:
He weighs freight himself and watches the honest chalk disappear.

I weigh everything now, myself, before it goes on the hook, and chalk the real weight on the crate.

The chalk gets washed off before the wagon leaves the yard. Every time. Somebody follows my crates around with a bucket, and I would very much like to know who pays him.
crane foreman bettis roke.appearanceStory: He weighs freight himself and watches the honest chalk disappear; rope gear belongs beside a crane where trust now requires his own hands.

fishwife orla mudge.name: Fishwife Orla Mudge
fishwife orla mudge.backstory:
She knows quay crews by their boots and listens for her son's deep-water news.

Not since I was thirty. I gut, I sell, and I know every crew on this quay by the sound of their boots.

My son is on a deep boat. He tells me the shoals moved. He does not tell me why he thinks so and I have not asked, and that is the arrangement we have had for two years and neither of us likes it.
fishwife orla mudge.appearanceStory: She knows quay crews by their boots and listens for her son's deep-water news; patched working cloth fits the fish stall she chose long ago.

yard master gervas tull.name: Yard Master Gervas Tull
yard master gervas tull.backstory:
He proposed paying woodland crews directly and was rebuked for it.

Pay the Mycelari for the coppice. Directly, as a crew, the way the estate's own day books say it used to be done.

I said that at a yard meeting and was told it would prejudice the case. Six hulls, four sets of timber, and a case. I build boats. I would like somebody to explain what a case floats on.
yard master gervas tull.appearanceStory: He proposed paying woodland crews directly and was rebuked for it; plain protective workwear suits a yard leader with a craftsman's conscience.

ropewalk mistress sabra hine.name: Ropewalk Mistress Sabra Hine
ropewalk mistress sabra hine.backstory:
A line failed below its rated load and she refuses to dismiss it.

My rope holds forty tons at the crane and eleven at a mast. It has never failed in my time.

Last month a hauling line parted on the Barrens run at nineteen tons, and it was my rope, and it was two years old. I have not slept properly since. Roke says the crate was over its manifest by a third. If Roke is right, my rope did not fail. I very much want Roke to be right.
ropewalk mistress sabra hine.appearanceStory: A line failed below its rated load and she refuses to dismiss it; ropecoil garments show the craft whose reliability defines her pride.

guild notary elber wisk.name: Guild Notary Elber Wisk
guild notary elber wisk.backstory:
His father lost a customs post for asking questions, leaving Elber's grudge on record.

Because anything from inside can be called a grudge, and my grudge is a matter of record: my father was a Custom House clerk and he was moved to a warehouse for asking about a seal.

Bring me a Crownwater customs stamp, a Barrens count book, or an Observatory hand that is not the Warden's, and I will stand in session and end a house. I have been ready six years.
guild notary elber wisk.appearanceStory: His father lost a customs post for asking questions, leaving Elber's grudge on record; formal plum and linen suit an oath with personal stakes.

astronomers' hall porter nyle.name: Astronomers' Hall Porter Nyle
astronomers' hall porter nyle.backstory:
He hears the chartsman's troublesome depths pass through the hall.

That the lake is doing something the astronomers cannot account for and would rather not advertise. A chartsman in Crownwater has three fathoms of floor arriving from nowhere. Nobody has put those two facts in a room.

I am a porter. I cannot put them in a room. But I know which cupboard the uncorrected plates are in, and nobody has asked me a single question in nine years.
astronomers' hall porter nyle.appearanceStory: He hears the chartsman's troublesome depths pass through the hall; orderly civic dress suits the overlooked keeper at an important door.

bell-warden cathis orr.name: Bell-Warden Cathis Orr
bell-warden cathis orr.backstory:
He records every changed ringing pattern and is waiting to be asked.

Instantly. I am not keeping a secret; I am waiting to be asked, which is a different and much lazier thing.

I keep the ringing book. Every change, every date, initialled. If somebody wants to prove the tide tables were corrected three years running without an announcement, my book does it in one page.
bell-warden cathis orr.appearanceStory: He records every changed ringing pattern and is waiting to be asked; a buckled coat gives the reliable bell worker a clear local silhouette.

lamp rock keeper fen tallow.name: Lamp Rock Keeper Fen Tallow
lamp rock keeper fen tallow.backstory:
Nine repeated returns earned a suggestion that he stop asking.

Nine times, in my quarterly return, in the same words. The returns go to the Factor's House.

Last year a boat came out with my supplies and a very pleasant man who suggested my glass was old and offered me a better one. I said mine was fine. He did not press it. I have never been more frightened by a conversation about optics.
lamp rock keeper fen tallow.appearanceStory: Nine repeated returns earned a suggestion that he stop asking; practical night clothes suit a light keeper who keeps writing anyway.

gullscar farmer rhys camber.name: Gullscar Farmer Rhys Camber
gullscar farmer rhys camber.backstory:
Six generations and a daughter who wants the farm keep him watching the water.

My family has had Gullscar six generations and I have a daughter who wants it. That is the whole of my reasoning.

If somebody from Whitehorn ever comes down with a proper map of what the mountain is doing, I will feed them for a month. I have said that in the market four years running and nobody has ever taken me up on it.
gullscar farmer rhys camber.appearanceStory: Six generations and a daughter who wants the farm keep him watching the water; patched work clothes belong to a future he hopes to hand on.

factor's clerk ivet somer.name: Factor's Clerk Ivet Somer
factor's clerk ivet somer.backstory:
The reeve walking his own post stopped being funny to her.

Because Reeve Coy has started walking his own letters to the ferry and everyone in this house thinks it is funny, and I do not.

If a notary ever swore a house seal misused, the evidence would be in the returned-post ledger, second cupboard, and I would be the one who had to explain how a stranger got at it. I am telling you I have thought about that, and I have not decided anything.
factor's clerk ivet somer.appearanceStory: The reeve walking his own post stopped being funny to her; plum office cloth dresses the clerk learning to recognize obstruction.

bastion sergeant odo fell.name: Bastion Sergeant Odo Fell
bastion sergeant odo fell.backstory:
His signing book contains lawful entries and no clear culprit.

Everyone who is supposed to be. That is the trouble - a signing book full of legitimate entries and no way to tell which one mattered.

If somebody ever wants to know who was in the seal room on a particular night, my book will tell them, and I will hand it over the moment somebody with the standing to ask asks. Nobody ever has.
bastion sergeant odo fell.appearanceStory: His signing book contains lawful entries and no clear culprit; a studded jack suits a guard relying on evidence as well as protection.

tessara.name: Tessara
tessara.backstory:
The antidote garden is losing slopes to fuel cutting and she says so aloud.

The kiln yard, in my opinion, and I have been shouted at for saying so. Bodri Hask's kilns need fuel, fuel means clearing the upper slopes, and a cleared slope on this hill is a slope that goes.

Bodri is not a villain. He is a very good potter with an order book from three regions. I have told him. He agrees with me and keeps firing, because the alternative is eleven families with no work.
tessara.appearanceStory: The antidote garden is losing slopes to fuel cutting and she says so aloud; pale healing colors make the garden's defender approachable.

orru moss.name: Orru Moss
orru moss.backstory:
He knows three people and one hill keep southern antidote available.

No. Tessara's garden makes it, Uwe Thal supplies the venom, I sell it. Three of us and a hill.

If any one of the three stops, southern Nymara has no antidote. I have made that argument to the quay broker, the Temple and the Stairhouse. Everyone agrees. Nothing has ever been done.
orru moss.appearanceStory: He knows three people and one hill keep southern antidote available; practical green clothes suit a provisioner guarding a fragile supply chain.

stairhouse warden ashi-len.name: Stairhouse Warden Ashi-Len
stairhouse warden ashi-len.backstory:
Prayers and silence greeted her missing-worker records, so she keeps two books.

To the Green Temple, the quay broker, and Hask himself. The Temple prayed, the broker asked me not to put it in writing, and Hask went white and kept firing.

So I keep two registers: the one the Stairhouse files, and the one in my own hand with the nine names and where each was working. The second is under the floor of this room.
stairhouse warden ashi-len.appearanceStory: Prayers and silence greeted her missing-worker records, so she keeps two books; an open-faced jack gives the registrar a practical watch role.

canopy village elder ruu-sath.name: Canopy Village Elder Ruu-Sath
canopy village elder ruu-sath.backstory:
He wants the kiln-water question judged by the Marchstone Priest.

Ask. That is the Ssarathi answer to everything and I am aware how it sounds.

Specifically: ask the Marchstone Priest at the Ruins to rule on whether the kilns' water use breaches the Stair's standing. It is a water question, so it is his to rule on, and he has not been asked in forty years because nobody here wants to be the one who asks.
canopy village elder ruu-sath.appearanceStory: He wants the kiln-water question judged by the Marchstone Priest; formal sashwork suits an elder who seeks standing through asking.

cenote diver vess-ilu.name: Cenote Diver Vess-Ilu
cenote diver vess-ilu.backstory:
Nine years ready at a shaft taught her that a gallery can emerge far away or nowhere.

Because a swimmer who enters that gallery does not come back up this shaft. They come out somewhere in the delta, or they do not come out.

I have been ready nine years. What I need is somebody at the delta end who knows where to wait. Labyrinth Sounder Ath-Rulu could tell me. He will not answer letters, because the last person who asked him this drowned.
cenote diver vess-ilu.appearanceStory: Nine years ready at a shaft taught her that a gallery can emerge far away or nowhere; light water-ready clothes suit patient courage.

green temple cantor nasha-ro.name: Green Temple Cantor Nasha-Ro
green temple cantor nasha-ro.backstory:
Eleven years of letters have left him less certain which temple came first.

Ours, obviously, and I am not certain, and I have never said that second part in a temple.

Warden Vashi-Lo at the delta temple writes to me. Four times a year for eleven years. We have never met. Her arguments are better than mine and I have started to enjoy that more than I should.
green temple cantor nasha-ro.appearanceStory: Eleven years of letters have left him less certain which temple came first; acolyte layers suit a ritual voice capable of private doubt.

kiln master bodri hask.name: Kiln Master Bodri Hask
kiln master bodri hask.backstory:
Cleaner imported coal would spare the hill but costs more than his yard's wages.

One. Emberseam coal out of Whitehorn, barged to the quay and hauled up. Hotter, cleaner, no slope at all.

It costs four times what cutting costs, and the difference is exactly the margin my order book runs on. Get me a coal contract at a price I could bear and I would put out the wood kilns in a week and help plant the slope myself.
kiln master bodri hask.appearanceStory: Cleaner imported coal would spare the hill but costs more than his yard's wages; patched forge cloth makes the pressure of his trade visible.

fern camp cook illa moss.name: Fern Camp Cook Illa Moss
fern camp cook illa moss.backstory:
Seven missing workers ate at her fire and spoke there more freely than at the works.

Because crews talk at a cook fire and do not talk at a works canteen, and somebody understands that.

Seven of the nine who did not come down last year ate at my fire the week before. I remember all seven. I could tell you what each of them ordered.
fern camp cook illa moss.appearanceStory: Seven missing workers ate at her fire and spoke there more freely than at the works; homespun clothes belong to a cook keeping human records.

rope-crossing rigger set-anu.name: Rope-Crossing Rigger Set-Anu
rope-crossing rigger set-anu.backstory:
Closing the crossing would halt the damaging kilns and strand the terraces.

The upper terraces are cut off in the wet season and the kilns shut, which solves Tessara's problem in the worst possible way.

I could say that now. It would stop the cutting. It would also finish Bodri and eleven families, and Bodri gave me my first work when I was fifteen. So I reset the anchor and say nothing, and I have been a coward about this for two years.
rope-crossing rigger set-anu.appearanceStory: Closing the crossing would halt the damaging kilns and strand the terraces; ropecoil layers fit the man holding those needs together.

garden physick uwe thal.name: Garden Physick Uwe Thal
garden physick uwe thal.backstory:
She planted a quiet bulb bed on unclaimed ravine ground when the offices would not act.

Tessara, who knew. Hask, who went white. The Green Temple, who prayed.

And I have quietly started a bulb bed in the ravine below the rope crossing, on ground nobody has any use for. Nine plants, four have taken. If the upper slope goes, four plants is what Nymara has left, and I am the only person who knows where they are.
garden physick uwe thal.appearanceStory: She planted a quiet bulb bed on unclaimed ravine ground when the offices would not act; rootwrap clothes suit medicine made by working hands.

quay broker halla prine.name: Quay Broker Halla Prine
quay broker halla prine.backstory:
Eleven fuel quotations have brought no order, though her commission would be the same.

Because I make my commission either way and arranging it is four months of work for nothing extra.

And because I have quoted him eleven times and eleven times he has said "not yet". There comes a point where you stop volunteering things to a man who will not do the arithmetic. If somebody else did the arranging I would broker it in a day and not charge for the introduction.
quay broker halla prine.appearanceStory: Eleven fuel quotations have brought no order, though her commission would be the same; formal trade cloth reflects the work she keeps offering.

cloud watch sentinel isse-ka.name: Cloud Watch Sentinel Isse-Ka
cloud watch sentinel isse-ka.backstory:
She files cloud patterns where nobody thinks to ask for them.

Nobody has asked. I send it to the Stairhouse with my weather returns and it goes in a drawer with the weather returns.

Surveyor Kell in the Barrens keeps a list of when a thing is due. Warden Prism has a region going flat. I have twenty-nine nights of light. Three people, three lists, four hundred miles apart.
cloud watch sentinel isse-ka.appearanceStory: She files cloud patterns where nobody thinks to ask for them; field scouting layers suit an observer whose evidence lives in the sky.

marchstone hermit oru-ves.name: Marchstone Hermit Oru-Ves
marchstone hermit oru-ves.backstory:
He knows a ruling can decide whether boundaries follow water or records.

Because the delta's channels are moving and every Ssarathi claim down there turns on whether a boundary follows the water or the record.

There is a ruling. It is in the Royal Archive filed under my name as a disciplinary matter, which is why nobody down there has ever found it. Priest Osu-Val knows it exists. Ask him what it is filed under and watch his face.
marchstone hermit oru-ves.appearanceStory: He knows a ruling can decide whether boundaries follow water or records; spare pale clothes suit a legal memory kept outside an office.

archivist sesh.name: Archivist Sesh
archivist sesh.backstory:
Thirty years defending the archive include twelve doubting its effects.

That the Archive is right in law and wrong in effect, and that I have spent thirty years defending a position I stopped believing about twelve years ago.

There is a ruling in this building that says a marchstone follows the water. It is real, it was made by a priest of this temple, and it is filed where nobody looks. I have never destroyed it. That is the whole of my courage.
archivist sesh.appearanceStory: Thirty years defending the archive include twelve doubting its effects; restrained scholarly layers carry that experienced, uneasy authority.

vess scale.name: Vess Scale
vess scale.backstory:
He knows the right to show a lineage never lapses.

Anyone who can show the line. That is the whole rule and it does not lapse.

There is a man on a Crownwater islet who claims the First Mouth. He does not know this case exists. He has never been here. And I am not permitted to write to a claimant, because a keeper who solicits a claim is a keeper with an interest.
vess scale.appearanceStory: He knows the right to show a lineage never lapses; formal sashwork keeps his duty to recognition visible.

sun-vault warden hass-ile.name: Sun-Vault Warden Hass-Ile
sun-vault warden hass-ile.backstory:
He serves a water mark he did not make and fears what exceeding it means.

Because the water was a hand's breadth below the mark both times, and the mark is the law, and I am the mark's servant not its author.

And because I am afraid of what is behind that door, which I have never said aloud in forty years. Nine stones and nobody living has read them. If the ninth says something inconvenient, my people's law changes in an afternoon and I am the man who opened it.
sun-vault warden hass-ile.appearanceStory: He serves a water mark he did not make and fears what exceeding it means; practical armor dresses a dutiful keeper rather than a ceremonial conqueror.

lineage reader ssiran-ta.name: Lineage Reader Ssiran-Ta
lineage reader ssiran-ta.backstory:
Three unpublished findings have made her question who controls a record.

I have said it in three findings and none has left this building, because a finding is not published unless the Archivist publishes it.

Sesh has not published any of the three. He has also never asked me to change one. In thirty years that is the only conversation he and I have ever really had.
lineage reader ssiran-ta.appearanceStory: Three unpublished findings have made her question who controls a record; green and linen fit a reader who still trusts careful documentation.

hatchery keeper nuu-sesh.name: Hatchery Keeper Nuu-Sesh
hatchery keeper nuu-sesh.backstory:
She hides a fragile hatchery fact from a good man bound to act.

Marshal Set-Kaal knows. He walks past the sand every morning and counts and has never said a word.

Warden Hass-Ile does not know and must not. He is a good man who would feel obliged to report it, and then eleven children a year would lose the only standing they will ever get.
hatchery keeper nuu-sesh.appearanceStory: She hides a fragile hatchery fact from a good man bound to act; pale care-giving clothes make her protective role legible.

cistern sounder vek-ora.name: Cistern Sounder Vek-Ora
cistern sounder vek-ora.backstory:
The archive filed his warnings and other offices refused them.

The Archivist, who filed it. The Marshal, who said it was not a water-gate matter. The Marchstone Priest, who asked nine excellent questions and then said he had no standing to act.

Everybody in this temple has told me it is somebody else's. I have started to think that is not four failures. I think it is one design.
cistern sounder vek-ora.appearanceStory: The archive filed his warnings and other offices refused them; field clothes suit measurements gathered despite institutional silence.

stela copyist ilhu-ren.name: Stela Copyist Ilhu-Ren
stela copyist ilhu-ren.backstory:
Nine rubbings are hidden outside the building that should protect them.

My rubbings to Ssiran-Ta, who went very quiet and asked me to keep them somewhere that is not this building.

They are somewhere that is not this building. Nine rubbings, in oilcloth. If somebody needed to prove the Archive's reading is a later invention, those nine sheets do it, and I would hand them over without a second's hesitation.
stela copyist ilhu-ren.appearanceStory: Nine rubbings are hidden outside the building that should protect them; pale working cloth fits a copyist whose custody has become resistance.

water-gate marshal set-kaal.name: Water-Gate Marshal Set-Kaal
water-gate marshal set-kaal.backstory:
He has recorded the water at mark while secretly setting it higher for six years.

No. A hand above it for six years, and I have written "at mark" in the gate book six years running.

The delta gets its water and I am a liar in a book nobody reads. If somebody audits that book I am finished and four thousand people will have had six good years, and I have decided that is an acceptable trade.
water-gate marshal set-kaal.appearanceStory: He has recorded the water at mark while secretly setting it higher for six years; plain protective plate suits a marshal keeping the delta alive at a cost.

lily court steward aa-nesh.name: Lily Court Steward Aa-Nesh
lily court steward aa-nesh.backstory:
She keeps forty rubbings rather than send them into another stalled office.

To the Marchstone Priest if it is a boundary, to the Archive if it is a record. Both would take it and both would sit on it.

What I have done instead is keep all forty rulings in one bundle with a summary at the front. Nine pages. The best thing I have ever written and it is addressed to nobody.
lily court steward aa-nesh.appearanceStory: She keeps forty rubbings rather than send them into another stalled office; formal sashwork suits custodianship used to preserve a future case.

marchstone priest osu-val.name: Marchstone Priest Osu-Val
marchstone priest osu-val.backstory:
A ruling he found nineteen years ago could change every channel claim.

Under Oru-Ves, disciplinary series, third gallery. I looked it up nineteen years ago and have never told anybody and never used it.

Cited in a live case, every delta claim on a moved channel turns overnight. I am one priest. I am not going to be the man who did that on his own initiative. Somebody would have to bring me a case.
marchstone priest osu-val.appearanceStory: A ruling he found nineteen years ago could change every channel claim; restrained ritual layers suit a priest who has kept consequential knowledge quiet.

undercroft digger rell marrow.name: Undercroft Digger Rell Marrow
undercroft digger rell marrow.backstory:
Foundation cut-marks gave her a lineage the upper record did not acknowledge.

Names, mostly. Crews and dates, which is what a foundation course always says.

And one line at the north corner that is not a name. It says the base was cut for a lineage that is not in the Archive's nine. A tenth mouth. I have told nobody in this building and I have been sitting on it for four years.
undercroft digger rell marrow.appearanceStory: Foundation cut-marks gave her a lineage the upper record did not acknowledge; patched excavation gear keeps the discoverer close to the stone.

falls measurer ith-anu.name: Falls Measurer Ith-Anu
falls measurer ith-anu.backstory:
She writes for the person who will cut a forty-second mark decades from now.

Nobody yet. They are for whoever cuts the forty-second, in about forty years.

That is the point. I am not writing for now. I am writing for a person who is not born, who will stand where I stand and know exactly what changed. It is the only kind of record I actually trust.
falls measurer ith-anu.appearanceStory: She writes for the person who will cut a forty-second mark decades from now; a field tunic gives long-view scholarship a working form.

coil bridge toll-taker ude-sar.name: Coil Bridge Toll-Taker Ude-Sar
coil bridge toll-taker ude-sar.backstory:
A marshal's pause on his bridge revealed a six-year water-book lie.

A Marshal of this temple, four years ago, who stopped, thought for a long while, and told me he had been setting the water gate a hand above the mark for two years and writing "at mark" in the book.

He paid the toll. He did not have to. Nobody has ever asked me what people say and I have never told anybody until now, and I intend to keep it that way except in your case, which I am also not going to explain.
coil bridge toll-taker ude-sar.appearanceStory: A marshal's pause on his bridge revealed a six-year water-book lie; clear civic colors fit an official whose useful evidence came from listening.

mara tide.name: Mara Tide
mara tide.backstory:
Exclusion from water standing made her the broker both sides could use.

I am Greyhaven. No water standing, never will have, and it makes me the only broker down here both sides will use.

That is not neutrality, it is exclusion, and I have built a very good living out of it. I would still rather have the vote.
mara tide.appearanceStory: Exclusion from water standing made her the broker both sides could use; plum and linen reflect trade built around a place she cannot claim.

jori reed.name: Jori Reed
jori reed.backstory:
He keeps offering a premium for antidote while the source hill burns.

Upstream. The Stair grows the bulb and the Stair is burning the slope it grows on.

I have written to Orru Moss four times offering a premium to secure supply. He writes back that a premium does not grow bulbs. He is right and I keep writing, because it is the only thing I can do from here.
jori reed.appearanceStory: He keeps offering a premium for antidote while the source hill burns; practical earth colors suit a shopkeeper anxious for the next supply.

tide hall speaker nen-ilsa.name: Tide Hall Speaker Nen-Ilsa
tide hall speaker nen-ilsa.backstory:
Nine requests for a ruling returned refusals by subject.

I am told there was a ruling forty years ago on the Verdant Stair about a marchstone. I have written to the Archive nine times asking for it by subject.

Nine times told no such ruling is indexed. That is probably true. It is also, I have begun to suspect, not the same thing as saying it does not exist.
tide hall speaker nen-ilsa.appearanceStory: Nine requests for a ruling returned refusals by subject; formal sashwork suits a speaker still trying to put law within reach of her people.

long market broker cass merrow.name: Long Market Broker Cass Merrow
long market broker cass merrow.backstory:
She negotiates in a market where water and livelihood keep changing.

The Stair getting its coal. Everyone here knows the kilns eat the slope the bulb grows on, and everyone here buys their storage jars from those kilns.

Halla Prine at the Stair quay says a joint contract would move a Whitehorn factor on price. I have wanted to put that to the delta potters for a year and they will not sit in a room with Stair people. Somebody who is neither might have better luck.
long market broker cass merrow.appearanceStory: She negotiates in a market where water and livelihood keep changing; gold-and-green trade cloth gives her a recognizable meeting place.

ferry post pilot ruk-tal.name: Ferry Post Pilot Ruk-Tal
ferry post pilot ruk-tal.backstory:
Piloting is the work that does not require water standing, and he is teaching his daughter.

I pilot. The one thing in this delta that needs no standing. Nobody asks a pilot which water he holds; they ask whether he can get them over the bar.

My daughter is learning. She will hold no water either and she will be able to go anywhere, and I have not decided whether that is a loss or the best thing I could give her.
ferry post pilot ruk-tal.appearanceStory: Piloting is the work that does not require water standing, and he is teaching his daughter; ropecoil clothing carries a portable family skill.

root landing elder ba-nuun.name: Root Landing Elder Ba-Nuun
root landing elder ba-nuun.backstory:
He seeks proof of upstream withholding rather than another accusation.

Because the water is being held upstream, and everyone here says that and nobody can prove it.

Marshal Set-Kaal at the temple gate sets the flow. Sounder Vek-Ora says the cistern is dropping. Falls Measurer Ith-Anu says the river carries less. Three people upstream with three measurements, and none of us has ever been in the same room.
root landing elder ba-nuun.appearanceStory: He seeks proof of upstream withholding rather than another accusation; formal pale sashwork suits an elder trying to make a case others must hear.

paddy watch sentry ossa-kel.name: Paddy Watch Sentry Ossa-Kel
paddy watch sentry ossa-kel.backstory:
The Speaker asked him not to record what he saw and the request still troubles him.

I told the Speaker. She listened an hour and then asked me not to write it down, which I did not expect from her and have thought about ever since.

I think she is afraid that if it is written the Hall must act, and acting means naming households, and naming households in this delta right now would be the end of the Hall. I still think she is wrong.
paddy watch sentry ossa-kel.appearanceStory: The Speaker asked him not to record what he saw and the request still troubles him; a scout vest fits the watch beside a changing paddy.

silt measurer ives kanton.name: Silt Measurer Ives Kanton
silt measurer ives kanton.backstory:
A careful silt report was finally treated as evidence rather than opinion.

Mirrorhold acknowledged it. The Tide Hall read it twice and Speaker Nen-Ilsa said it was the first thing anyone had shown her that was not an opinion.

Then she asked whether I could prove where the extra silt comes from, and I cannot, because that means measuring on the Verdant Stair, and I have no standing to put a stake in anyone else's river.
silt measurer ives kanton.appearanceStory: A careful silt report was finally treated as evidence rather than opinion; field layers dress a measurer whose numbers now matter.

labyrinth guide hess-uru.name: Labyrinth Guide Hess-Uru
labyrinth guide hess-uru.backstory:
Four early losses taught her to refuse unsafe parties.

Four. Four out of about two hundred, all in the first three years, all before I learned to refuse people.

I refuse a lot now. Anybody who wants to go past the third gallery, anybody carrying a lamp they will not let me check, and anybody who tells me they are only looking. Nobody is only looking down there.
labyrinth guide hess-uru.appearanceStory: Four early losses taught her to refuse unsafe parties; kneepads and fieldboots suit a guide who carries experience instead of bravado.

green temple warden vashi-lo.name: Green Temple Warden Vashi-Lo
green temple warden vashi-lo.backstory:
A Stoneborn could date the temple courses and settle an old claim.

Yes, and this is the part that keeps me awake: by a Stoneborn. Cut-marks date stone, and my temple and Nasha-Ro's both have original courses exposed.

Two mornings' work for somebody who can read a chisel. I have written to Cantor Nasha-Ro about it eleven times over eleven years and never once had the courage to say it plainly, because I might be the copy.
green temple warden vashi-lo.appearanceStory: A Stoneborn could date the temple courses and settle an old claim; modest ritual clothes suit a warden asking for material proof.

south shrine cantor tem-ossa.name: South Shrine Cantor Tem-Ossa
south shrine cantor tem-ossa.backstory:
Naming the dead person's channel gave him nine boards of water claims.

Every one, with the channel. That is the ritual: you cannot be sung out without your channel said aloud.

Which means I have, on nine boards in this shrine, a complete list of every water claim abandoned in nineteen years. Speaker Nen-Ilsa has never asked to see it. Nobody has. It is carved into the walls of a public building and it is the best evidence in the delta.
south shrine cantor tem-ossa.appearanceStory: Naming the dead person's channel gave him nine boards of water claims; pale acolyte layers carry a sacred duty that has become evidence.

east watch runner bel kiddow.name: East Watch Runner Bel Kiddow
east watch runner bel kiddow.backstory:
A packet split in the rain and exposed payments against channel names.

It has begun to. Six years for that house, and last spring one of the packets came apart in the rain and I saw the top sheet without meaning to.

A list of channel names with money against each one. I sealed it, delivered it, said nothing, and have not been able to put it down since.
east watch runner bel kiddow.appearanceStory: A packet split in the rain and exposed payments against channel names; a scout vest suits a runner carrying more knowledge than intended.

stelae court scribe ann-sesh.name: Stelae Court Scribe Ann-Sesh
stelae court scribe ann-sesh.backstory:
Nine unrecorded households made her stop saying she does not know so quickly.

I do not know, and I have stopped saying that quite so quickly.

Nine stelae, nine unrecorded households, and one Westhaven house writing five sheets a fortnight to an archive. I have a list of the nine with witnesses and dates. One page. One honest copyist upstream could check it in an afternoon.
stelae court scribe ann-sesh.appearanceStory: Nine unrecorded households made her stop saying she does not know so quickly; green office cloth fits a scribe willing to pursue a missing record.

drowned chapel verger tomas rill.name: Drowned Chapel Verger Tomas Rill
drowned chapel verger tomas rill.backstory:
Eleven years below the water line convinced him someone must keep a light without wanting a prize.

Yes. Constantly, for eleven years, and I have not once considered leaving.

Somebody has to be down here holding a light. If it stops being me it will be somebody who wants something, and then the cap comes off.
drowned chapel verger tomas rill.appearanceStory: Eleven years below the water line convinced him someone must keep a light without wanting a prize; acolyte dress suits that steady custodianship.

wreck assessor juna coll.name: Wreck Assessor Juna Coll
wreck assessor juna coll.backstory:
A Ssarathi watermark crossed her bench and she wrote down what it meant.

Not for eight years. Then a piece crossed my bench with a Ssarathi water-mark cut in the underside, and I knew exactly what I was holding and what it meant, and I wrote it down anyway.

If anybody ever opens that box, my initials are on the sheet that proves it. I have made my peace with being the evidence.
wreck assessor juna coll.appearanceStory: A Ssarathi watermark crossed her bench and she wrote down what it meant; pale work cloth makes honest inspection her visible role.

bilge diver sath-uma.name: Bilge Diver Sath-Uma
bilge diver sath-uma.backstory:
She would descend for a keeper of her own water and refuse a salvage house.

If a keeper of my own water asked, yes. If a salvage house asked, no, and I would tell the whole delta which house had asked.

They have not asked me. They have asked four other divers, and all four said no, and I would like to know what happens when they run out of divers to ask.
bilge diver sath-uma.appearanceStory: She would descend for a keeper of her own water and refuse a salvage house; light working clothes put skill ahead of purchased display.

temple ordinal vaun cress.name: Temple Ordinal Vaun Cress
temple ordinal vaun cress.backstory:
He is so glad to see the few yearly pilgrims that he cools his welcome in the gallery.

Nine a year, perhaps. Most are pilgrims and two or three are lost.

I am always so pleased to see them that I have to go and stand in the cold gallery a moment first, so as not to alarm anybody. Sera Owl says everyone knows. Sera Owl is probably right.
temple ordinal vaun cress.appearanceStory: He is so glad to see the few yearly pilgrims that he cools his welcome in the gallery; simple wool carries a warm heart inside an exact order.

ice cantor sera owl.name: Ice Cantor Sera Owl
ice cantor sera owl.backstory:
Four voices in ice are her favorite sound and losing hearing her greatest fear.

Enormously. Four voices in a room made of ice is the best sound in the world and I will not be argued with.

My one fear is going deaf. Vesk the sounder lost half his hearing to the ice and still goes back down, and every time he passes the Temple I want to ask how he stands it, and I never do.
ice cantor sera owl.appearanceStory: Four voices in ice are her favorite sound and losing hearing her greatest fear; pale warm wool fits a cantor protecting the conditions of her work.

vault calibrator oleth ryne.name: Vault Calibrator Oleth Ryne
vault calibrator oleth ryne.backstory:
Four letters and one frightening visit have left her seeking an independent door count.

I have written to Ione Brass four times. She came once, listened, and went away white.

What I want is somebody to walk the four doors with me and count what is behind each against my ledger. Two days of extremely dull work, and I have not been able to get one person in this region to do it with me.
vault calibrator oleth ryne.appearanceStory: Four letters and one frightening visit have left her seeking an independent door count; glowline study gear marks the investigator at the vault.

resonance warden duro kesk.name: Resonance Warden Duro Kesk
resonance warden duro kesk.backstory:
He wants an outsider to say what the chamber will not let him say aloud.

I would rather not say it aloud in this chamber. I would rather somebody who is not a Glasswarden did the saying.

Ryne has asked for a door-by-door count for a year. Do it with her. If the ledger and the chambers disagree, the disagreement names the person, and then it will not be me who named them.
resonance warden duro kesk.appearanceStory: He wants an outsider to say what the chamber will not let him say aloud; crystalward protective layers suit a warden listening under strain.

vault digger sten marrow.name: Vault Digger Sten Marrow
vault digger sten marrow.backstory:
Refused a works-book entry, he cut his finding into the wall.

I told Kesk. He looked at it a long time and asked me not to write it in the works book.

I did not write it in the works book. I cut it into the wall behind the niche instead, in cut-script, with the date. He cannot read cut-script. Nobody down here can.
vault digger sten marrow.appearanceStory: Refused a works-book entry, he cut his finding into the wall; patched excavation clothes belong to a record keeper whose medium is stone.

estate housekeeper merrild vane.name: Estate Housekeeper Merrild Vane
estate housekeeper merrild vane.backstory:
Nineteen years taught her how a request can reach books the family would prefer closed.

In writing, to the housekeeper, citing a specific year. Then it is a request to the house and not to the family, and I am obliged to produce the volume.

Nobody knows that. It is in the house rules, which are in the cellar, which nobody may consult without leave. I have found that funny for nineteen years and I have finally stopped.
estate housekeeper merrild vane.appearanceStory: Nineteen years taught her how a request can reach books the family would prefer closed; formal service colors reflect knowledge of the house's own rules.

estate sporewright umber coll.name: Estate Sporewright Umber Coll
estate sporewright umber coll.backstory:
Forty-one isolated years in a cellar left him knowledge that needs a letter to survive.

To the housekeeper, who already knows, and to a court, if one ever asked.

What I would really like is for Sillow to know it exists. I cannot tell her - I have been down here since I was fourteen and I am well out of range of the Motherroot. Somebody would have to carry it. On foot. Like a letter.
estate sporewright umber coll.appearanceStory: Forty-one isolated years in a cellar left him knowledge that needs a letter to survive; rootwrap clothes carry the woodland connection he has lost.

barrow lamplighter ess corrow.name: Barrow Lamplighter Ess Corrow
barrow lamplighter ess corrow.backstory:
A warm sealed wall taught her never to miss another round.

I did, the first year. I sat outside the sealed wall of the eighth a whole night with my hand on the stone, and about the fourth hour the stone got warm.

Not hot. Warm, like a person leaning on the other side. I got up, finished my round, and have never sat there again, and I have also never once been late for a round in eleven years.
barrow lamplighter ess corrow.appearanceStory: A warm sealed wall taught her never to miss another round; a buckled night coat suits the keeper who lights both chambers and closed walls.

grave-debt keeper dorn marrow.name: Grave-Debt Keeper Dorn Marrow
grave-debt keeper dorn marrow.backstory:
Nineteen years of seeking four witnesses have kept a lawful return impossible.

In principle. Return an equivalent to the chamber, have it recorded on the stone, have the court witness it, and the field can be cut closed.

It has never been done. It needs a mason willing to cut a return field, a smith willing to make the equivalent, a Speaker to sit, and somebody willing to walk out there at night carrying something worth stealing. Four people. I have been looking for four people nineteen years.
grave-debt keeper dorn marrow.appearanceStory: Nineteen years of seeking four witnesses have kept a lawful return impossible; severe formal cloth suits a debt keeper treating old chambers as live business.

archive copyist uln-sath.name: Archive Copyist Uln-Sath
archive copyist uln-sath.backstory:
Four refused requests keep her from taking a rubbing kit to nine stelae.

One person walking to nine stelae with a rubbing kit and coming back. Perhaps five weeks.

I have asked for the leave four times. Always refused on staffing. I would go tomorrow, on my own time. I am not permitted to leave the Archive unaccompanied, which is a rule made for a different reason that has become extremely convenient.
archive copyist uln-sath.appearanceStory: Four refused requests keep her from taking a rubbing kit to nine stelae; pale practical cloth fits a diligent copyist already prepared to walk.

archive marshal ren-kaal.name: Archive Marshal Ren-Kaal
archive marshal ren-kaal.backstory:
Eleven years guarding custody have left him willing to escort a lawful seal anywhere.

Because my whole office is custody, and a Marshal who advertises the way in is not doing custody.

But I have thought about it every year for eleven, and I will tell you plainly: bring me a Lily Court seal and I will walk you to any gallery in this building myself, including the disciplinary series.
archive marshal ren-kaal.appearanceStory: Eleven years guarding custody have left him willing to escort a lawful seal anywhere; an open-faced jack fits authority with a narrow but real path through it.

custom house clerk perrit dole.name: Custom House Clerk Perrit Dole
custom house clerk perrit dole.backstory:
He kept an unanswered Crownwater letter with eleven salvage entries.

A Crownwater officer, two years ago, asking about deep-water salvage declared as shallows. I pulled him eleven entries.

He wrote to Reeve Coy about it and never got a reply, so he wrote to me instead, and I have kept the letter. I would very much like to be asked about it by somebody who can do something.
custom house clerk perrit dole.appearanceStory: He kept an unanswered Crownwater letter with eleven salvage entries; navy and linen suit an unshowy clerk holding useful evidence.

guild archivist wenna skell.name: Guild Archivist Wenna Skell
guild archivist wenna skell.backstory:
Nineteen years among books let information endure when she cannot make powerful people listen.

I have tried twice at guild dinners and both times he assumed I was making conversation.

I am extremely bad at telling important people important things. I have been an archivist nineteen years partly because it means the information sits there whether or not I can say it out loud.
guild archivist wenna skell.appearanceStory: Nineteen years among books let information endure when she cannot make powerful people listen; acolyte study layers fit her chosen refuge.

physick apprentice osu-nell.name: Physick Apprentice Osu-Nell
physick apprentice osu-nell.backstory:
She amended a formulation record with the crucial reduced bulb rather than a polite euphemism.

Tessara set the titre. She told me to write it in the book as "revised formulation" and did not look at me while she said it.

I wrote it as "revised formulation, reduced bulb". She has read the book. She has not changed it back. I think that is the closest thing to a thank-you I am going to get.
physick apprentice osu-nell.appearanceStory: She amended a formulation record with the crucial reduced bulb rather than a polite euphemism; pale healing colors mark an apprentice learning useful honesty.

stair provisioner belm ott.name: Stair Provisioner Belm Ott
stair provisioner belm ott.backstory:
Four years of free rope showed him that equipment cannot give a crew a safety habit.

I put a coil of rope in every kiln crew's order whether they ask or not and I do not charge. Four years now.

My margin is thinner than it should be and I have never regretted it. The yard has never noticed. If they ever do, I will tell them it is breakage.
stair provisioner belm ott.appearanceStory: Four years of free rope showed him that equipment cannot give a crew a safety habit; earth-colored trade clothes fit generosity tempered by regret.

labyrinth sounder ath-rulu.name: Labyrinth Sounder Ath-Rulu
labyrinth sounder ath-rulu.backstory:
An answered letter helped send a man into water he did not return from.

Because the last person who wrote to me was a Verdant Stair diver asking where the cenote gallery comes out, and I wrote back, and a man went into that water and did not come out.

Four years ago. Vess-Ilu writes every season. I have answered none. If she came here herself and stood where I could see her face while I said it, I would tell her exactly where to wait, and that I think it comes out in the fifth, and that I have no idea whether that is survivable.
labyrinth sounder ath-rulu.appearanceStory: An answered letter helped send a man into water he did not return from; light subdued clothes suit a sounder who now wants to see the listener's decision.

lens grinder ottil wren.name: Lens Grinder Ottil Wren
lens grinder ottil wren.backstory:
Nineteen years of quiet bench work made a cracked lens change the meaning of silence.

Two thirds of one, at a bench, alone, in silence, because a lens hears you breathe.

People assume that is a hardship. It is the only place I have ever been able to think. What I minded about the crack was not the work. It was that for nine days afterwards I could not go back into that room, and it was the first time in nineteen years the quiet had ever been the wrong sort.
lens grinder ottil wren.appearanceStory: Nineteen years of quiet bench work made a cracked lens change the meaning of silence; pale workwear fits the exacting craft she wants to return to.

hall register sefton ames.name: Hall Register Sefton Ames
hall register sefton ames.backstory:
Nineteen years at one desk taught him the Citadel's lonely lives while nobody asked his name-book anything.

Because nobody thinks to ask the register. Every person in this Citadel walks past my desk twice a day and looks at the wall behind my head.

I have been waiting five weeks for somebody to ask. You asked. I want you to understand that this is the best day I have had in some time.
hall register sefton ames.appearanceStory: Nineteen years at one desk taught him the Citadel's lonely lives while nobody asked his name-book anything; linen and plum give the overlooked clerk a face.

wind-cave echo reader tul marrow.name: Wind-Cave Echo Reader Tul Marrow
wind-cave echo reader tul marrow.backstory:
Two years of a crawl she cannot fit through have left her asking the air for a smaller listener.

The seventh is beyond a crawl I do not fit through. Esku hears the same thing from above and cannot get in either.

What is needed is somebody smaller than me with a lamp and no imagination. I have said that to the empty air for two years and you are the first person to hear it.
wind-cave echo reader tul marrow.appearanceStory: Two years of a crawl she cannot fit through have left her asking the air for a smaller listener; kneepads suit her patient cave work.

cave prospector ashen duru.name: Cave Prospector Ashen Duru
cave prospector ashen duru.backstory:
He knows the seventh cave is filling rather than shrinking.

For nothing? No. For a reason? Perhaps.

Tul Marrow says the seventh has got smaller. I have been in the seventh. It has not got smaller - it has got fuller, and what is filling it did not come in through the crawl.
cave prospector ashen duru.appearanceStory: He knows the seventh cave is filling rather than shrinking; patched field layers fit a cynical prospector who has seen the difference himself.

roadwright callun ferre.name: Roadwright Callun Ferre
roadwright callun ferre.backstory:
Twenty-two springs clearing his father's mistaken ditch kept a dead man's good name.

Every spring, twenty-two years, I dig the wrong ditch out and do not cut a new one.

Cutting a new one takes three days and tells the whole town that a well-liked dead man was careless. Three days a year is a fair price for that, and my wife thinks I am ridiculous, and she is right.
roadwright callun ferre.appearanceStory: Twenty-two springs clearing his father's mistaken ditch kept a dead man's good name; knee-protected work clothes carry that quietly repeated repair.

ash sister melle quen.name: Ash Sister Melle Quen
ash sister melle quen.backstory:
A year away from snow made her letters home more vivid.

I like the people, who talk to strangers, which nobody does at home. I like the bread. I do not like being warm at night; I cannot think properly.

And I have started writing to Sister Arel about snow, which I have not seen for a year, and my letters have got much better since I stopped being able to look out of a window at it.
ash sister melle quen.appearanceStory: A year away from snow made her letters home more vivid; lighter wool preserves the cold order's habits in warm Emberhaven.

emberhaven chandler ory task.name: Emberhaven Chandler Ory Task
emberhaven chandler ory task.backstory:
A vanished prospector bought too many candles and enough wick to lay a line.

Ninety candles to one man in one purchase, three winters ago. A prospector heading into the Cinder Wastes.

Ninety candles is four months of dark. He did not come back and nobody has ever asked after him, and I have not been able to decide whether to feel guilty about the sale or about not asking.
emberhaven chandler ory task.appearanceStory: A vanished prospector bought too many candles and enough wick to lay a line; a buckled supplier's coat fits the sale she still thinks about.

ferry clerk bram ollow.name: Ferry Clerk Bram Ollow
ferry clerk bram ollow.backstory:
Nine hundred crossings repeated his father's route without an afternoon beyond the quay.

Nine hundred times, and never gone further than the Mirrorhold quay. I get off, hand over the manifest, get back on.

My father made the crossing four thousand times and saw the same forty yards of Nymara. It is a family tradition and I am aware how stupid it sounds.
ferry clerk bram ollow.appearanceStory: Nine hundred crossings repeated his father's route without an afternoon beyond the quay; tidy navy cloth suits a life packed into a manifest schedule.

windward scout iselle karr.name: Windward Scout Iselle Karr
windward scout iselle karr.backstory:
A candle stub beyond the last waymark stays with her more than two aborted patrols.

Twice, as far as the last waymark, and both times I turned back for reasons I could not have defended to Captain Tor.

The second time I found a candle stub. Just one, upright, burned down, on a stone at the edge of the ash, facing east.
windward scout iselle karr.appearanceStory: A candle stub beyond the last waymark stays with her more than two aborted patrols; a scout vest gives restless watching a practical shape.

stormglass cutter vek doun.name: Stormglass Cutter Vek Doun
stormglass cutter vek doun.backstory:
His father's deafening cart taught him to cut every ringing piece before shipping it.

It breaks the tube. A cut piece rings and stops. A whole piece rings and keeps ringing, and two whole pieces in a box together will find each other.

I know because my father did it, once, in a cart, on the Emberhaven road. He was deaf a month and never told anybody but me, and I have cut every single piece since.
stormglass cutter vek doun.appearanceStory: His father's deafening cart taught him to cut every ringing piece before shipping it; close work layers belong on a craftsperson whose caution is inherited.

salt reader anu berel.name: Salt Reader Anu Berel
salt reader anu berel.backstory:
Being right about a failing camp well brought her into exile.

Because I read the wind at a camp on the eastern grazing and told the Herd-Mother the well was going bad, and I was right, and being right about a well is not a thing a camp forgives quickly.

I will go back. Not yet. When I do I would like to be able to say I read something bigger than a well and was right about that too.
salt reader anu berel.appearanceStory: Being right about a failing camp well brought her into exile; wrapped steppe cloth carries the home she means to return to with stronger proof.

shelf warden ottoline frey.name: Shelf Warden Ottoline Frey
shelf warden ottoline frey.backstory:
An early shelf closure saved a fishing crew's empty hut eleven years ago.

Once, eleven years ago, in a warm February. Four hundred yards and a fishing crew's hut. The hut was empty because I had closed the shelf that morning.

Nobody in this town has ever mentioned it. Not once in eleven years. I have come to understand that this is how they say thank you and I have stopped waiting for the other kind.
shelf warden ottoline frey.appearanceStory: An early shelf closure saved a fishing crew's empty hut eleven years ago; warm patrol layers fit authority earned without public thanks.

ice fisher hulden sarr.name: Ice Fisher Hulden Sarr
ice fisher hulden sarr.backstory:
Thirty-one years of depth letters to his brother became a water record neither discussed.

Always, thirty-one years, one conversation a week, and it has been enough.

My brother went to Nymara. He writes about Westhaven, eleven thousand people and four bells. I read the letters on the ice, which he would find funny, and I have never once envied him.
ice fisher hulden sarr.appearanceStory: Thirty-one years of depth letters to his brother became a water record neither discussed; a trapper coat belongs to that contented life on the ice.

channel pilot ussa-tem.name: Channel Pilot Ussa-Tem
channel pilot ussa-tem.backstory:
A closed home channel sent her to six years surveying forty crossings.

My channel closed. There is nothing to go back to and no standing to go back with.

Six years, forty crossings surveyed. If the delta ever wants a pilot who can prove where the water was, they know where I am. Nobody has written. I keep surveying.
channel pilot ussa-tem.appearanceStory: A closed home channel sent her to six years surveying forty crossings; ropecoil workwear carries a skill she keeps ready for a reply.

peat cutter molle rane.name: Peat Cutter Molle Rane
peat cutter molle rane.backstory:
Eight years beyond the grove's reach made her own thoughts frightening and then enjoyable.

Every hour. I am four hundred miles out of range of anything and have been alone in my own head eight years, which for one of us is a peculiar kind of quiet.

I came for a season to see whether I could. I could. That was the answer and I have never worked out why I stayed to keep proving it.
peat cutter molle rane.appearanceStory: Eight years beyond the grove's reach made her own thoughts frightening and then enjoyable; patched work clothing suits a migrant who kept proving she could stay.

reach gardener sen thallow.name: Reach Gardener Sen Thallow
reach gardener sen thallow.backstory:
Four letters asking a cousin for a culture never asked how he was.

Perhaps. Drying, salting, or a cellar culture like the ones my family keeps in Amberwood. I have written to my cousin four times.

He is in an estate cellar four hundred miles away and has never answered, which I do not resent, because for one of us to write a letter at all means we are both a very long way from home.
reach gardener sen thallow.appearanceStory: Four letters asking a cousin for a culture never asked how he was; rootwrap clothing keeps the gardener's distant family connection visible.

seed keeper iora vane.name: Seed Keeper Iora Vane
seed keeper iora vane.backstory:
She has handled an unopened ancient seed jar forty times without risking the changed soil.

Because I would be planting something that stopped growing here two hundred years ago, in ground warmer than it was, in a region where everything grows twice as fast.

I have taken the jar out perhaps forty times and never opened it. If somebody with more nerve than me wanted one, I would need a very good argument and I would probably lose it.
seed keeper iora vane.appearanceStory: She has handled an unopened ancient seed jar forty times without risking the changed soil; careful pale garden clothes fit protective curatorship.

cinder prospector rull marrow.name: Cinder Prospector Rull Marrow
cinder prospector rull marrow.backstory:
Four trips beyond the last marker found ash standing in unchanged eastward ripples.

Six miles. Past the last marker, past where the scholar turns back, to a place where the ash is glassy and stands in ripples like a beach.

Ripples in ash mean something moved through it at ground level, wide, going east. Not wind - wind makes dunes. I have been back four times and they have not changed by a hair.
cinder prospector rull marrow.appearanceStory: Four trips beyond the last marker found ash standing in unchanged eastward ripples; patched excavation layers suit a fearless, unsettling witness.

ash cartographer nema quist.name: Ash Cartographer Nema Quist
ash cartographer nema quist.backstory:
Her sister sought the origin that polite replies would not explain.

Amberwood's chaplain, the Barrens Observatory, and Scholar Meret at Four Gates. Two replies, both polite, neither useful.

The thing I cannot get anyone to look at is that both fields move east, and east from Amberwood is the Amethyst Barrens, and east from here is the sea. Whatever this is, it is not going somewhere. It is coming from somewhere, and it is still coming.
ash cartographer nema quist.appearanceStory: Her sister sought the origin that polite replies would not explain; field survey clothes make the cartographer's private stake in her rates visible.

old pyke.name: Old Pyke
old pyke.backstory:
A grove path-keeper who stayed after other cutters stopped taking the old road.

I kept the path for the coppice crews before the boars took the yard. Most cutters found another road. I stayed, because somebody should remember which gate leads home.

The bark coat is working clothes, not a title. When a party returns I check the last person through before I bar the gate. Trees can wait for a season. People should not have to.
old pyke.appearanceStory: A grove path-keeper who stayed after other cutters stopped taking the old road; bark and root layers suit years of checking gates against the sounder's return.

hesk varne.name: Hesk Varne
hesk varne.backstory:
An icefall route guide who learned to judge a party by whether it could keep moving together.

I guided silver crews up the stair before the ice closed it. A brave party is easy to find. A party that notices its slowest walker is rarer, and more use on that span.

I kept the fur coat and this post. The coat gets me through the waiting; the post lets me tell the next group what I learned before they have to learn it in the cold.
hesk varne.appearanceStory: An icefall route guide who learned to judge a party by whether it could keep moving together; a fur-lined coat carries that patient cold-weather experience.

ssethis the doorkeeper.name: Ssethis the Doorkeeper
ssethis the doorkeeper.backstory:
A former offering-road escort now keeps watch over both mouths of the old court.

I escorted offering parties to the old court. I knew both mouths, and I used to think that knowing a road meant knowing what waited at its end. The court corrected me.

Now I keep the door. This jack has been repaired more often than replaced. It is for standing here when people come back frightened, not for pretending the causeway belongs to me.
ssethis the doorkeeper.appearanceStory: A former offering-road escort now keeps watch over both mouths of the old court; a working jack suits someone who remembers how many parties came back.

widow carrow.name: Widow Carrow
widow carrow.backstory:
After losing a companion on the bog board she took up the watch at its entrance.

My husband went along the bog board and did not come home. For a while I walked to its entrance every morning as though being there could alter the count. Eventually I began warning the people who walked past me.

The dark wool was mourning once. Now it is simply warm. If I can persuade one party to keep moving where he stopped, I have done more than wait.
widow carrow.appearanceStory: After losing a companion on the bog board she took up the watch at its entrance; dark wool and worn boots turn mourning into warnings for the next travelers.

tollmaster quent.name: Tollmaster Quent
tollmaster quent.backstory:
He once counted lawful crossings and now counts groups returning from the flooded hall.

I was appointed to count crossings when the hall still had an ordinary road. The water took the road and most of the office. It did not take the habit of keeping a count.

Now I count people out and back. I wear the old road guard's jack because the causeway is no longer a clerk's errand. A paid toll is a small success. A whole returning party is a better one.
