tollmaster quent.appearanceStory: He once counted lawful crossings and now counts groups returning from the flooded hall; weathered protection suits a toll keeper whose real duty became survival.

rider anse.name: Rider Anse
rider anse.backstory:
A former herd outrider stayed near the canyon after learning where a line breaks under attack.

I rode the outside of the herds, where a frightened animal makes the whole line turn. The canyon taught me that people can break a line just as quickly.

I took this post after I stopped riding every season. I kept the vest and the riding boots. You need room to move here, and a reminder that the last person matters as much as the first.
rider anse.appearanceStory: A former herd outrider stayed near the canyon after learning where a line breaks under attack; steppe riding gear preserves a working rider's mobility.

grinder vell.name: Grinder Vell
grinder vell.backstory:
A shard grinder who stopped treating the deep cut's hum as ordinary workshop noise.

I ground shards for instruments and called the deep cut's hum workshop noise. Then a finished piece kept sounding after the wheel stopped. I put it down and went outside to listen.

That is how I came to this bridge. I still dress for careful work, not a charge into the court. Someone should hear a change while there is still time to warn the people crossing.
grinder vell.appearanceStory: A shard grinder who stopped treating the deep cut's hum as ordinary workshop noise; glowline layers keep craft and careful listening together.

bund warden ilse.name: Bund Warden Ilse
bund warden ilse.backstory:
A paddy-watch veteran took the exposed bund post to keep harvest crews out of the drowned ground.

I watched paddies before I watched this bund. When the flooded ground began taking crews, I came up onto the bank to see where the safe work ended.

The scout vest lets me move along the narrow top without fighting my own clothes. I have no wish to be remembered as brave. I would like the next harvest crew to come back with everyone it took out.
bund warden ilse.appearanceStory: A paddy-watch veteran took the exposed bund post to keep harvest crews out of the drowned ground; a scout vest suits a protector who needs to move along narrow banks.

ammet sorrel.name: Ammet Sorrel
ammet sorrel.backstory:
Inherited memory includes the first olive planting on this hill.

My people inherit memory the way yours inherit furniture. Some of mine is older than these trees.

One of my grandmothers remembers planting the first olive on this hill. She does not remember why. I find I do not need her to.
ammet sorrel.appearanceStory: Inherited memory includes the first olive planting on this hill; rootwrap layers suit a keeper more concerned with growing and welcome than the committee's record.

ostrid hollin.name: Ostrid Hollin
ostrid hollin.backstory:
She has counted 4,106 fallen arrivals and 4,106 returns.

Every one, in a column, with the hour. Four thousand one hundred and six since I took the post, and four thousand one hundred and six came back.

A Votary measures before she trusts. I have measured, and I trust it. I still count.
ostrid hollin.appearanceStory: She has counted 4,106 fallen arrivals and 4,106 returns; warm wool dresses a cold-order keeper whose exactness has become trust.

marta quell.name: Marta Quell
marta quell.backstory:
She traded a bed for an anxious guest's boat counting and kept a wreck dog as light equipment.

Tavi. He walked up nine days ago and asked whether the light needed anything done in exchange for a bed. I said it needed boats counted. He has not missed one since.

He thinks he owes the isle something. I have told him the isle does not keep accounts. He is Orun; he does not believe me.
marta quell.appearanceStory: She traded a bed for an anxious guest's boat counting and kept a wreck dog as light equipment; a warm workcoat fits practical protection of strays.

tavi unhar.name: Tavi Unhar
tavi unhar.backstory:
A proud nineteen-year-old counts boats to repay three olives and shelter.

Because Marta needed it done and I needed to give something back. On the steppe a guest who takes bread owes the house until the house says otherwise.

I took three olives before anyone said a word to me. Nobody has said otherwise.
tavi unhar.appearanceStory: A proud nineteen-year-old counts boats to repay three olives and shelter; simple riding clothes keep the steppe guest visible beneath his new shore duty.

odo fenn.name: Odo Fenn
odo fenn.backstory:
He grudgingly admires the beavers rebuilding his own reed packing.

Nothing. They are better engineers than the people who built the walls. They simply build where I would rather they did not, out of my own reed packing.

Three of them have been at the sluice since spring. I want them off the sluice, not out of the world. They come back. That is the arrangement.
odo fenn.appearanceStory: He grudgingly admires the beavers rebuilding his own reed packing; ropecoil workwear fits an engineer negotiating with other good engineers.

tessa.name: Tessa
tessa.backstory: She keeps Landfall's spell tomes within reach of new arrivals, explaining the first healing and fire spells before offering more demanding studies.
tessa.appearanceStory: A coordinated Twilight coat, legguards and boots frame a crystal prism staff; her uncovered head keeps the tome keeper approachable.

rellan.name: Rellan
rellan.backstory: A Stoneborn veteran of the gauntlet roads, he gathers adventurers in Landfall and sends each party toward a challenge worthy of its strength.
rellan.appearanceStory: The complete Phoenix heroic cuirass, legguards and boots mark a veteran of difficult roads; he wears no helmet so arrivals can see his Stoneborn face.
